source.text: אִם־תָּשׁ֨וּב יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל׀נְאֻם־יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י תָּשׁ֑וּב וְאִם־תָּסִ֧יר שִׁקּוּצֶ֛יךָ מִפָּנַ֖י וְלֹ֥א תָנֽוּד׃

records.literal_gloss: If you return, Israel, declares Yahweh, to me you will return; and if you remove your detestable things from before me, and not you will wander,

en.L: If you return, Israel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you shall return; and if you put away your detestable things from before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and do not wander,
en.B: If you return, Israel, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q return to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. If you put your detestable idols out of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight and no longer stray,
en.R: Israel, if you come back, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q come back to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. If you take your disgusting idols away from where I can see them and stop wandering away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}},

es.L: Si vuelves, Israel, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} volverás; y si quitas tus abominaciones de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} y no andas errante,
es.B: Si vuelves, Israel, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q vuelve a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Si quitas tus ídolos abominables de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} vista y ya no te desvías,
es.R: Israel, si regresas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q regresa a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Si quitas tus ídolos repugnantes de donde yo los veo y dejas de alejarte de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}},

fr.L: Si tu reviens, Israël, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q c’est vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} que tu reviendras ; et si tu ôtes tes abominations de devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et que tu n’erres plus,
fr.B: Si tu reviens, Israël, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q reviens vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Si tu ôtes tes idoles abominables de devant {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face et que tu ne t’égares plus,
fr.R: Israël, si tu reviens, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q reviens vers {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Si tu enlèves tes idoles dégoûtantes de devant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux et si tu cesses de t’éloigner de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}},

sw.L: Ukirudi, Israeli, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q utanirudia {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}; na ukiyaondoa machukizo yako mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, wala hutatangatanga,
sw.B: Ukirudi, Israeli, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nirudie {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Ukiziondoa sanamu zako za kuchukiza mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na kuacha kupotea,
sw.R: Israeli, ukirudi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q nirudie {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}. Ukiziondoa sanamu zako za kuchukiza mahali ninapoweza kuziona, na kuacha kutangatanga mbali nami,

vi.L: Nếu ngươi trở lại, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q thì hãy trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; và nếu ngươi dẹp bỏ những vật ghê tởm của ngươi khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không lang thang nữa,
vi.B: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, nếu con trở lại, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q thì hãy trở lại cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nếu con dẹp bỏ các thần tượng ghê tởm khỏi mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không còn đi lạc nữa,
vi.R: Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, nếu con quay về, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q thì hãy quay về với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Nếu con dẹp bỏ các thần tượng ghê tởm khỏi trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và thôi đi lạc xa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},

ko.L: 이스라엘아, 네가 돌아오려거든, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 나에게로 돌아오너라. 네가 네 가증한 것들을 내 앞에서 치워 버리고 방황하지 않으면,
ko.B: 이스라엘아, 네가 돌아오겠다면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나에게로 돌아오너라. 네가 역겨운 우상들을 내 눈앞에서 치워 버리고 더 이상 헤매지 않으면,
ko.R: 이스라엘아, 네가 돌아오려고 한다면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 나에게로 돌아오너라. 네가 그 역겨운 우상들을 내 눈에 보이지 않는 곳으로 치워 버리고 더 이상 나를 떠나 헤매지 않으면,

pt.L: Se voltares, Israel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} voltarás; e se removeres as tuas coisas detestáveis de diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e não andares errante,
pt.B: Se voltares, Israel, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q volta para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Se tirares da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} vista os teus ídolos detestáveis e não andares mais sem rumo,
pt.R: Israel, se voltares, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q volta para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Se tirares da {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} frente os teus ídolos nojentos e parares de te afastar de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}},

am.L: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ብትመለስ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ወደ እኔ ትመለሳለህ፤ አስጸያፊ ነገሮችህንም ከፊቴ ብታስወግድ፣ ባትቅበዘበዝም፣
am.B: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ብትመለስ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ወደ እኔ ተመለስ። አስጸያፊ ጣዖታትህን ከፊቴ ብታስወግድና ከእንግዲህ ባትቅበዘበዝ፣
am.R: እስራኤል ሆይ፣ ብትመለስ፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ወደ እኔ ተመለስ። የሚያስጸይፉ ጣዖታትህን ከፊቴ ብታርቅና ከእኔ መራቅህን ብታቆም፣

hi.L: यदि तुम लौटो, हे इस्राएल, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q तो मेरे पास लौटो; और यदि तुम अपनी घृणित वस्तुओं को मेरे सामने से दूर करो और न भटको,
hi.B: हे इस्राएल, यदि तुम लौटो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q तो मेरे पास लौट आओ। यदि तुम अपनी घिनौनी मूरतों को मेरी आँखों के सामने से हटा दो और फिर न भटको,
hi.R: हे इस्राएल, यदि तुम लौटना चाहते हो, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q तो मेरे पास लौट आओ। यदि तुम अपनी घिनौनी मूरतों को मेरी आँखों के सामने से हटा दो और मुझसे दूर भटकना छोड़ दो,

ru.L: Если ты вернёшься, Израиль, — слово {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, — \q ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}} ты вернёшься; и если ты удалишь свои мерзости от {{deity_pronoun:моего|Моего}} лица и не будешь скитаться,
ru.B: Если ты вернёшься, Израиль, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q вернись ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Если ты уберёшь свои мерзкие идолы с {{deity_pronoun:моих|Моих}} глаз и больше не будешь блуждать,
ru.R: Израиль, если ты возвращаешься, — говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, — \q возвращайся ко {{deity_pronoun:мне|Мне}}. Если ты уберёшь своих отвратительных идолов туда, где {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} их не увижу, и перестанешь уходить от {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}},

ja.L: もしあなたが立ち帰るなら、イスラエルよ、――{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の言葉―― \q わたしのもとに立ち帰るのだ。もし、あなたの忌まわしいものをわたしの前から取り除き、さまよわないなら、
ja.B: イスラエルよ、もし立ち帰るなら、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は告げる。 \q わたしのもとに立ち帰りなさい。もし忌まわしい偶像をわたしの前から取り除き、もうさまよわないなら、
ja.R: イスラエルよ、もし戻って来るなら、と{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は言う。 \q わたしのところへ戻って来なさい。もし汚らわしい偶像を、わたしの見える所から取り除き、わたしから離れてさまようのをやめるなら、

decisions.choice: if you return, return to me: Israel's turning must be a turning to the LORD himself
alternatives: if you return, Israel, you may come back (to your place, to favor)
decisions.reason: The verb "return" comes twice, and "to me" stands first in the second clause for emphasis. The call answers 3:10, where Judah turned back only "with falsehood": a real return is a return to the LORD himself. The second clause could also be read as a promise, "you may come back", restored to God's favor and the land (15:19 plays on the same verb in this way). Either way the condition is a return to God.

decisions.choice: detestable things: idols and the objects of foreign worship
decisions.reason: The word is used for idols and the gods they stand for, things the LORD finds loathsome (7:30; 13:27; 2 Kings 23:13, 24). Putting them away "from before me" means removing them from the LORD's presence, out of the land and the temple.

decisions.choice: wander: drift back and forth, stray
decisions.reason: The verb describes moving about with no settled place, as Cain was to be a wanderer (Genesis 4:12, 14). Here it pictures Israel drifting between the LORD and other gods (2:23, 36).

decisions.choice: the conditions run on into verse 2, where the result follows
decisions.reason: "If" governs several clauses (return, remove, do not wander, swear truly), and the promise for the nations comes only at the end of verse 2. The sentence continues across the verse division.

decisions.choice: detestable idols / disgusting idols ... wandering away from me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "idols" to show what the detestable things were (m2). Readable also says whom Israel wanders from, which the Hebrew leaves implied.

decisions.choice: the condition left open at the end of verse 1 (않으면,), with the result in verse 2
alternatives: | Verses 1-2 are one Hebrew sentence. Korean puts the conditions first and closes the sentence in verse 2, so each verse keeps its own words; "declares the LORD" stays where the Hebrew has it, as an inserted phrase.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person (वे, उनका). This holds for every record of this file.

decisions.choice: घृणित वस्तुएँ (L); घिनौनी मूरतें (B, R)
decisions.reason: shiqqutsim are the idols and objects of foreign worship (m2): Literal keeps "detestable things" as घृणित वस्तुएँ, as 2:7 keeps the abomination; Balanced and Readable name them as idols, as the English does.

decisions.choice: shuv "立ち帰る" (L, B), "戻って来る" (R), as chapter 3; shiqqutsim "忌まわしいもの" (L), "忌まわしい偶像" (B), "汚らわしい偶像" (R).
decisions.reason: The call of chapter 3 continues with the same verbs; the conditions run on into 4:2 (m4).

source.text: וְנִשְׁבַּ֨עְתָּ֙ חַי־יְהוָ֔ה בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת בְּמִשְׁפָּ֣ט וּבִצְדָקָ֑ה וְהִתְבָּ֥רְכוּ ב֛וֹ גּוֹיִ֖ם וּב֥וֹ יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and you swear, [As] lives Yahweh, in truth, in justice and in righteousness, then will bless themselves in him nations, and in him they will boast.

en.L: and swear, "[As] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives," \q in truth, in justice and in righteousness, \q then nations will bless themselves by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} they will make their boast.
en.B: and swear, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives," \q in truth, with justice and with righteousness, \q then the nations will bless themselves by {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and take pride in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: and if you make your promises by saying, "As surely as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} lives," \q and you mean it, and do what is fair and right, \q then the nations will ask {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to bless them, and they will be proud to belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: y juras: «Vive {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}», \q en verdad, en derecho y en justicia, \q entonces las naciones se bendecirán en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se gloriarán.
es.B: y juras: «Tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive», \q con verdad, con derecho y con justicia, \q entonces las naciones se bendecirán en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y se sentirán orgullosas de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: y si haces tus promesas diciendo: «Tan cierto como que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} vive», \q y lo dices en serio, y haces lo que es justo y recto, \q entonces las naciones {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pedirán que las bendiga, y se sentirán orgullosas de pertenecer a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.

fr.L: et que tu jures : « [Aussi vrai que] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant », \q avec vérité, avec droiture et avec justice, \q alors les nations se béniront par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, et en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} elles se glorifieront.
fr.B: et que tu jures : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant », \q avec vérité, avec droiture et avec justice, \q alors les nations se béniront par {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et mettront en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} leur fierté.
fr.R: et si tu fais tes promesses en disant : « Aussi vrai que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vivant », \q en étant sincère et en faisant ce qui est juste et droit, \q alors les nations {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} demanderont de les bénir, et elles seront fières de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartenir.

sw.L: na ukaapa, "[Kama] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo," \q kwa kweli, kwa hukumu na kwa haki, \q ndipo mataifa watajibariki kwake, na kwake watajivuna.
sw.B: na ukaapa, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo," \q kwa kweli, kwa haki na kwa uadilifu, \q ndipo mataifa yatajibariki kwa {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na kujivuna kwake.
sw.R: na ukitoa ahadi zako kwa kusema, "Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aishivyo," \q ukimaanisha hivyo na kutenda yaliyo sawa na ya haki, \q ndipo mataifa yatamwomba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} awabariki, nao watajivunia kuwa mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

vi.L: và thề rằng: "[Thật như] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống," \q trong chân thật, trong công bình và trong công chính, \q thì các dân tộc sẽ nhờ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúc phước cho mình, và trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chúng sẽ khoe mình.
vi.B: và thề rằng: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống," \q cách chân thật, công bình và công chính, \q thì các dân tộc sẽ nhân danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà chúc phước cho mình và lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm tự hào.
vi.R: và nếu con hứa nguyện bằng câu: "Thật như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hằng sống," \q với lòng thành thật, làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng, \q thì các dân tộc sẽ xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban phước cho mình, và họ sẽ hãnh diện được thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 진실과 정의와 의로 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계신다" 하고 맹세하면, \q 민족들이 그로 말미암아 스스로 복을 빌고, 그를 자랑할 것이다.
ko.B: 진실하고 공정하고 의롭게 \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고" 맹세하면, \q 민족들이 그의 이름으로 복을 빌고 그를 자랑으로 삼을 것이다.
ko.R: 네가 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 살아 계심을 두고" 약속하면서 \q 그 말을 진심으로 하고, 공정하고 옳은 일을 하면, \q 민족들이 그에게 복을 구하고 그에게 속한 것을 자랑스럽게 여길 것이다.

pt.L: e jurares: "[Tão certo como] vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}", \q em verdade, em justiça e em retidão, \q então nações se abençoarão {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, e {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} se gloriarão.
pt.B: e jurares: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}", \q com verdade, com justiça e com retidão, \q então as nações vão se abençoar {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}} e se orgulhar {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: e se fizeres as tuas promessas dizendo: "Tão certo como vive {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}", \q e se falares a sério e fizeres o que é justo e certo, \q então as nações vão pedir que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} as abençoe, e vão ter orgulho de pertencer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}.

am.L: «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና» ብለህ ብትምል፣ \q በእውነት፣ በፍርድና በጽድቅ፣ \q ሕዝቦች በእርሱ ራሳቸውን ይባርካሉ፤ በእርሱም ይመካሉ።
am.B: «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና» ብለህ ብትምል፣ \q በእውነት፣ በፍትሕና በጽድቅ፣ \q ሕዝቦች በእርሱ ራሳቸውን ይባርካሉ፤ በእርሱም ይኮራሉ።
am.R: ቃል ስትገባም «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእውነት ሕያው እንደ ሆነ» ብለህ ብትምል፣ \q ይህንም ከልብህ ብትል፣ ትክክልና ፍትሐዊ የሆነውንም ብታደርግ፣ \q ሕዝቦች እርሱ እንዲባርካቸው ይለምኑታል፤ የእርሱ በመሆናቸውም ይኮራሉ።

hi.L: और यह शपथ खाओ, "जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ," \q सच्चाई से, न्याय से और धार्मिकता से, \q तो जातियाँ उन्हीं के द्वारा आशीष माँगेंगी, और उन्हीं पर गर्व करेंगी।
hi.B: और यह शपथ खाओ, "जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ," \q सच्चाई के साथ, न्याय और धार्मिकता के साथ, \q तो देश उन्हीं के नाम से आशीष माँगेंगे और उन्हीं पर गर्व करेंगे।
hi.R: और यदि तुम यह कहकर वचन दो, "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के जीवन की शपथ," \q और सच्चे मन से कहो, और जो उचित और सही है वही करो, \q तो देश उनसे आशीष माँगेंगे और उनके होने पर गर्व करेंगे।

ru.L: и будешь клясться: «Жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}», \q в истине, в правосудии и в праведности, \q то народы будут благословляться {{deity_pronoun:им|Им}} и {{deity_pronoun:им|Им}} будут хвалиться.
ru.B: и будешь клясться: «Верно, как жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}», \q в истине, правосудии и праведности, \q то народы будут благословляться {{deity_pronoun:им|Им}} и гордиться {{deity_pronoun:им|Им}}.
ru.R: и если ты будешь давать обещания, говоря: «Верно, как жив {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}», \q и будешь говорить искренне и поступать честно и справедливо, \q тогда народы будут просить {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} благословить их и будут гордиться тем, что принадлежат {{deity_pronoun:ему|Ему}}.

ja.L: そして「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる」と、 \q 真実と公正と正義をもって誓うなら、 \q 国々はその方によって自らを祝福し、その方を誇りとする。
ja.B: 「{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は生きておられる」と、 \q 真実と公正と正義をもって誓うなら、 \q 国々はその方によって祝福を受け、その方を誇りとする。
ja.R: そして、もしあなたが「生きておられる{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}にかけて」と言って約束し、 \q 本気でそれを守り、公平で正しいことを行うなら、 \q 国々はその方に祝福を求め、その方のものであることを誇りに思うようになる。

decisions.choice: "As the LORD lives": the oath that calls on the living God as witness
decisions.reason: Israel was to swear by the LORD's name and by no other god (Deuteronomy 6:13; 10:20; Jeremiah 12:16). The oath counts only when it is backed by truth, justice and righteousness; in 5:2 the people say "As the LORD lives" and swear falsely.

decisions.choice: nations will bless themselves in him: the promise to Abraham fulfilled through Israel's return
decisions.reason: The same form of the verb is used in the promise to Abraham that all nations will bless themselves by his offspring (Genesis 22:18; 26:4; compare 12:3). When Israel turns back to God with a true heart, the nations will see it and seek blessing from Israel's God. The reflexive form can mean that they will invoke his name when they bless, or that they will find blessing for themselves in him.

decisions.choice: in him: the LORD
decisions.reason: The nearest person named is the LORD, by whom Israel swears, and boasting "in the LORD" is a common phrase (9:23; Psalm 34:3). The pronoun could point to Israel, as the one through whom blessing comes in Genesis, but the oath and the boasting both look to God.

decisions.choice: you mean it, and do what is fair and right ... proud to belong to him
decisions.reason: Readable puts the three nouns "in truth, in justice and in righteousness" as what the person swearing does, and spells out "boast in him" as being proud to belong to him.

decisions.choice: [As] the LORD lives (Literal); As surely as the LORD lives (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew oath is literally "living is the LORD". Literal brackets the supplied "As"; Balanced and Readable use the oath wording of 12:16 and of 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: "Vive el SEÑOR" (L); "Tan cierto como que el SEÑOR vive" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath formula as the Samuel terms note sets it for Spanish.

decisions.choice: Kama BWANA aishivyo
decisions.reason: The oath in the wording of the published 1 Kings 17:1 and 17:12; Literal brackets "Kama" as the English brackets "As".

decisions.choice: "[Aussi vrai que] le SEIGNEUR est vivant" (L); "Aussi vrai que le SEIGNEUR est vivant" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath wording of the French Samuel (1 Samuel 14:39; 19:6), with the supplied words in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: "avec vérité, avec droiture et avec justice"
alternatives: "en vérité, dans le droit et la justice"
decisions.reason: *Mishpat* and *tsedaqah* as a pair are "le droit et la justice"; with the preposition repeated, "droiture" reads better beside "vérité" and "justice".

decisions.choice: "Thật như CHÚA hằng sống"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's form for the oath; Literal brackets "Thật như", which the Hebrew leaves unsaid.

decisions.choice: "주께서 살아 계신다" 하고 맹세하면 (Literal); "주께서 살아 계심을 두고" 맹세하면 (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The oath formula follows the Samuel note's wording (주께서 살아 계심을 두고 맹세하다). Here God speaks of himself in the third person (그로, 그를), so Korean gives no honorific to the pronoun but keeps 계신다 inside the people's own oath.

decisions.choice: [Tão certo como] vive o SENHOR (L); Tão certo como vive o SENHOR (B, R); justiça, retidão
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the oath (m1) takes the Portuguese of 1 Samuel 14:39 and 1 Kings 17:1, with "Tão certo como" bracketed at Literal, as the English brackets "As". Mishpat and tsedaqah are "justiça" and "retidão", the pair Isaiah 1:21 sets.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሕያው ነውና" (Literal, Balanced); Readable as its English level
decisions.reason: The oath "As the LORD lives" keeps the wording settled in Joshua to Kings on main. "Justice" (mishpat) is "ፍርድ" at Literal and "ፍትሕ" at Balanced, as the terms list has it.

decisions.choice: जीवित {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की शपथ (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के जीवन की शपथ (R)
decisions.reason: The oath "as the LORD lives" is worded as 1 Samuel 14:39 has it in this translation: जीवित प्रभु की शपथ at Literal and Balanced, प्रभु के जीवन की शपथ at Readable.

decisions.choice: «Жив ГОСПОДЬ» (L); «Верно, как жив ГОСПОДЬ» (B, R)
decisions.reason: The oath is literally "living is the LORD": Literal keeps the two words, Balanced and Readable add "верно, как" to make it an oath, as the English levels add "as surely as".

decisions.choice: chai YHWH "「{D}は生きておられる」" (L, B), "「生きておられる{D}にかけて」" (R), as Hosea 4:15; be'emet bemishpat uvitsdaqah "真実と公正と正義をもって" (L, B), mishpat and tsedaqah as the prophetic key-word table.
decisions.reason: The Hosea and Isaiah forms; the oath is in the swearer's mouth, so it has a respect form.

decisions.choice: bo "その方によって" for "in him", the LORD spoken of by God himself in the third person, without a respect form ("誇りとする").
decisions.reason: m3 is uncertain; the footnote gives the other reading.

source.text: כִּי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה לְאִ֤ישׁ יְהוּדָה֙ וְלִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְאַֽל־תִּזְרְע֖וּ אֶל־קוֹצִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh to [the] man of Judah and to Jerusalem: Break up for yourselves fallow ground, and do not sow among thorns.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to the man of Judah and to Jerusalem: \q Break up for yourselves fallow ground, \q and do not sow among thorns.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this to the {{gender:people|men}} of Judah and to Jerusalem: \q Plow up your unplowed ground, \q and do not sow among thorns.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: \q Your lives are like hard ground that needs plowing. Plow it up! \q Do not plant your seed among thorns.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} al hombre de Judá y a Jerusalén: \q {{plural_you:Aren|Arad}} para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} el barbecho, \q y no {{plural_you:siembren|sembréis}} entre espinos.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto a la gente de Judá y a Jerusalén: \q {{plural_you:Aren|Arad}} la tierra que no ha sido arada, \q y no {{plural_you:siembren|sembréis}} entre espinos.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a la gente de Judá y de Jerusalén: \q {{plural_you:Sus vidas|Vuestras vidas}} son como tierra dura que necesita ser arada. ¡{{plural_you:Árenla|Aradla}}! \q No {{plural_you:siembren su semilla|sembréis vuestra semilla}} entre espinos.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à l’homme de Juda et à Jérusalem : \q Défrichez-vous un terrain neuf, \q et ne semez pas parmi les épines.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci aux {{gender:habitants|hommes}} de Juda et à Jérusalem : \q Labourez vos terres en friche, \q et ne semez pas parmi les épines.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aux habitants de Juda et de Jérusalem : \q Votre vie est comme une terre dure qu’il faut labourer. Labourez-la ! \q Ne plantez pas vos graines au milieu des épines.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kwa mtu wa Yuda na kwa Yerusalemu: \q Jilimieni mashamba mapya, \q wala msipande kati ya miiba.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awaambiavyo watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu: \q Limeni mashamba yenu yasiyolimwa, \q wala msipande kati ya miiba.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analowaambia watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu: \q Maisha yenu ni kama ardhi ngumu inayohitaji kulimwa. Ilimeni! \q Msipande mbegu zenu kati ya miiba.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này với người Giu-đa và với Giê-ru-sa-lem: \q Hãy vỡ đất hoang cho mình, \q và đừng gieo giữa gai góc.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy với dân Giu-đa và với Giê-ru-sa-lem: \q Hãy cày xới đất bỏ hoang của các ngươi, \q và đừng gieo giữa bụi gai.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem: \q Đời sống các ngươi như đất cứng cần được cày xới. Hãy cày xới nó lên! \q Đừng gieo hạt giữa bụi gai.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 사람과 예루살렘에게 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 너희는 묵은 땅을 갈아엎어라. \q 가시덤불 속에 씨를 뿌리지 마라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다 사람들과 예루살렘에게 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 너희는 묵혀 둔 밭을 갈아엎어라. \q 가시덤불 속에 씨를 뿌리지 마라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 유다와 예루살렘 사람들에게 하시는 말씀이다. \q 너희의 삶은 갈아엎어야 할 굳은 땅과 같다. 그 땅을 갈아엎어라! \q 가시덤불 속에 너희 씨를 뿌리지 마라.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ao homem de Judá e a Jerusalém: \q Rompam para vocês a terra em pousio, \q e não semeiem entre espinhos.
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} {{gender:ao povo|aos homens}} de Judá e a Jerusalém: \q Arem a terra que ficou sem cultivo \q e não semeiem entre espinhos.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz ao povo de Judá e de Jerusalém: \q A vida de vocês é como uma terra dura que precisa ser arada. Arem essa terra! \q Não plantem a sua semente entre espinhos.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለይሁዳ ሰውና ለኢየሩሳሌም እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q ለራሳችሁ ያልታረሰውን መሬት ገምሱ፤ \q በእሾህም መካከል አትዝሩ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለይሁዳ ሰዎችና ለኢየሩሳሌም እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q ያልታረሰውን መሬታችሁን አርሱ፤ \q በእሾህም መካከል አትዝሩ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለይሁዳና ለኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ሕይወታችሁ መታረስ እንደሚያስፈልገው ደረቅ መሬት ነው። አርሱት! \q ዘራችሁን በእሾህ መካከል አትዝሩ።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा के पुरुष से और यरूशलेम से यों कहते हैं: \q अपने लिए परती भूमि जोतो, \q और काँटों के बीच मत बोओ।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा के लोगों से और यरूशलेम से यह कहते हैं: \q अपनी बिना जुती भूमि को जोत डालो, \q और काँटों के बीच बीज मत बोओ।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोगों से यह कहते हैं: \q तुम्हारा जीवन उस कड़ी भूमि के समान है जिसे जोतने की ज़रूरत है। उसे जोत डालो! \q काँटों के बीच अपना बीज मत बोओ।

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} мужу Иуды и Иерусалиму: \q Распашите себе новину \q и не сейте среди терновника.
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} жителям Иуды и Иерусалиму: \q Вспашите вашу невспаханную землю \q и не сейте среди терновника.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} народу Иуды и Иерусалима: \q Ваша жизнь как твёрдая земля, которую нужно вспахать. Вспашите её! \q Не сейте семена среди колючек.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はユダの人とエルサレムに、こう言われる。 \q 耕されていない地を耕せ。 \q いばらの中に種を蒔くな。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はユダの人々とエルサレムに、こう言われる。 \q 耕されていない地を掘り起こしなさい。 \q いばらの中に種を蒔いてはならない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、ユダとエルサレムの人々に、こう言われる。 \q あなたたちの生き方は、耕す必要のある固い土地のようだ。それを耕しなさい！ \q いばらの中に種を蒔いてはいけない。

decisions.choice: break up fallow ground: make a new start, as a farmer plows hard, neglected land before sowing
decisions.reason: Fallow ground has been left unplowed and has grown hard and weedy. Breaking it up is the first work before a new crop. Hosea uses the same words for seeking the LORD (Hosea 10:12): the people's lives must be turned over completely before anything good can grow.

decisions.choice: do not sow among thorns: do not add a show of repentance to lives still full of old sins
decisions.reason: Seed sown where thorns still grow is choked and comes to nothing (12:13; Genesis 3:18). A turning to God that leaves the old ways in place will not bear fruit.

decisions.choice: the man of Judah: everyone in Judah
decisions.reason: "Man" is singular here and stands for the whole population, men and women alike, as "inhabitant of Jerusalem" does (verse 4; Isaiah 5:3).

decisions.choice: the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the singular "man of Judah". Balanced and Readable say "people", since everyone in Judah is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: Your lives are like hard ground that needs plowing
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of plowing stands for, so that the reader does not take it as farming advice (m1).

decisions.choice: "la gente de Judá", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "gente" covers men and women, so the English gender setting needs no Spanish span; Literal keeps "el hombre de Judá".

decisions.choice: hivi ndivyo BWANA awaambiavyo
decisions.reason: The settled formula takes the verb "kuambia" here because the Hebrew names the people spoken to.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "የይሁዳ ሰዎች"
decisions.reason: Amharic "ሰዎች" already includes women and men, so the English span "people / men" (here and in 4:4) needs none.

decisions.choice: यहूदा के लोग, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced has a gender span (people / men) on "the man of Judah". Hindi लोग already includes men and women, so the Hindi has no span here or in verse 4; Literal keeps the singular पुरुष, as the English Literal keeps "man".

decisions.choice: жителям Иуды, no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Balanced has a gender span for "the men of Judah". Russian жители already means everyone who lives there, men and women, so no span is needed; the same in verse 4.

decisions.choice: niru lakhem nir "耕されていない地を耕せ" (L), "…を掘り起こしなさい" (B), as Hosea 10:12; R explains the picture as the English Readable.
decisions.reason: Hosea 10:12 was worded for this verse; the same form here.

decisions.choice: 'ish Yehudah "ユダの人" (L), "ユダの人々" (B, R) with no gender span (the English B has {{gender:people|men}}); likewise 4:4.
decisions.reason: "人々" already includes women; the style guide gives no span there.

source.text: הִמֹּ֣לוּ לַיהֹוָ֗ה וְהָסִ֨רוּ֙ עָרְל֣וֹת לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָ֖ה וְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם פֶּן־תֵּצֵ֨א כָאֵ֜שׁ חֲמָתִ֗י וּבָעֲרָה֙ וְאֵ֣ין מְכַבֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י רֹ֥עַ מַעַלְלֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and remove [the] foreskins of your heart, man of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, lest go out like fire my wrath and burn, and there is no one quenching, because of [the] evil of your deeds.

en.L: Be circumcised to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and remove the foreskins of your heart, \q man of Judah and inhabitants of Jerusalem, \q or {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath will go out like fire, and burn, and there will be no one to quench [it], \q because of the evil of your deeds.
en.B: Circumcise yourselves for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; circumcise your hearts, \q {{gender:people|men}} of Judah and people of Jerusalem, \q or {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} wrath will flare up like fire and burn, and no one will put it out, \q because of the evil you have done.
en.R: Circumcise yourselves to belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Circumcise your hearts: open them to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q you people of Judah and Jerusalem. \q If you do not, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger will blaze out like a fire. It will burn, and no one will be able to put it out, \q because of the evil things you have done.

es.L: {{plural_you:Circuncídense|Circuncidaos}} para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y {{plural_you:quiten|quitad}} los prepucios de {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}}, \q hombres de Judá y habitantes de Jerusalén, \q no sea que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira salga como fuego, y arda, y no haya quien [la] apague, \q por la maldad de {{plural_you:sus obras|vuestras obras}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Circuncídense|Circuncidaos}} para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; {{plural_you:circunciden su corazón|circuncidad vuestro corazón}}, \q gente de Judá y habitantes de Jerusalén, \q o {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira estallará como fuego y arderá, y nadie la podrá apagar, \q por el mal que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Circuncídense|Circuncidaos}} para pertenecer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. {{plural_you:Circunciden su corazón|Circuncidad vuestro corazón}}: {{plural_you:ábranlo|abridlo}} a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, \q gente de Judá y de Jerusalén. \q Si no lo {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}}, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira se encenderá como un fuego. Arderá, y nadie la podrá apagar, \q por las cosas malas que {{plural_you:han hecho|habéis hecho}}.

fr.L: Soyez circoncis pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ôtez les prépuces de votre cœur, \q homme de Juda et habitants de Jérusalem, \q de peur que {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur ne sorte comme un feu et ne brûle, sans que personne [l’]éteigne, \q à cause de la méchanceté de vos actions.
fr.B: Circoncisez-vous pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; circoncisez votre cœur, \q {{gender:habitants|hommes}} de Juda et habitants de Jérusalem, \q sinon {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} fureur éclatera comme un feu et brûlera, et personne ne pourra l’éteindre, \q à cause du mal que vous avez fait.
fr.R: Circoncisez-vous pour appartenir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Circoncisez votre cœur : ouvrez-le pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q habitants de Juda et de Jérusalem. \q Sinon, {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère s’enflammera comme un feu. Elle brûlera, et personne ne pourra l’éteindre, \q à cause du mal que vous avez fait.

sw.L: Jitahirini kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mkaondoe magovi ya mioyo yenu, \q enyi mtu wa Yuda na wakaaji wa Yerusalemu, \q ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} isije ikatoka kama moto, ikawaka, wala hakuna wa kuizima, \q kwa sababu ya uovu wa matendo yenu.
sw.B: Jitahirini kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; itahirini mioyo yenu, \q enyi watu wa Yuda na watu wa Yerusalemu, \q la sivyo ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itawaka kama moto, wala hakuna atakayeweza kuizima, \q kwa sababu ya maovu mliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Jitahirini ili muwe mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Itahirini mioyo yenu, yaani, ifungueni kwangu, \q enyi watu wa Yuda na Yerusalemu. \q Msipofanya hivyo, hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} itawaka kama moto. Itaunguza, wala hakuna mtu atakayeweza kuizima, \q kwa sababu ya mambo maovu mliyoyatenda.

vi.L: Hãy chịu cắt bì cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hãy cắt bỏ bao quy đầu của lòng các ngươi, \q hỡi người Giu-đa và dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q kẻo cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bùng ra như lửa và thiêu đốt, chẳng ai dập tắt được, \q vì những việc làm gian ác của các ngươi.
vi.B: Hãy cắt bì cho mình để thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy cắt bì lòng các ngươi, \q hỡi dân Giu-đa và dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q kẻo cơn thịnh nộ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bừng lên như lửa và thiêu đốt, không ai dập tắt được, \q vì những điều ác các ngươi đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy cắt bì để thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy cắt bì lòng các ngươi, nghĩa là mở lòng ra cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q hỡi dân Giu-đa và Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Nếu không, cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ bùng lên như lửa. Nó sẽ cháy, và không ai dập tắt được, \q vì những điều ác các ngươi đã làm.

ko.L: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 할례를 받고 너희 마음의 포피를 벗겨 내어라, \q 유다 사람과 예루살렘 주민들아. \q 그렇지 않으면 내 분노가 불처럼 나가 타오를 것이고, 끌 자가 없을 것이다. \q 너희 행실의 악 때문이다.
ko.B: 너희는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 할례를 행하여라. 너희 마음에 할례를 행하여라, \q 유다 사람들과 예루살렘 사람들아. \q 그렇지 않으면 내 분노가 불처럼 일어나 타오를 것이고, 아무도 그것을 끄지 못할 것이다. \q 너희가 저지른 악 때문이다.
ko.R: 할례를 받고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 속한 사람이 되어라. 너희 마음에 할례를 받아 나에게 마음을 열어라, \q 유다와 예루살렘 사람들아. \q 그렇지 않으면 내 분노가 불처럼 타오를 것이다. 그 불이 타오르면 아무도 끌 수 없을 것이다. \q 너희가 저지른 악한 일들 때문이다.

pt.L: Circuncidem-se para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e tirem os prepúcios do coração de vocês, \q homem de Judá e habitantes de Jerusalém, \q para que a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira não saia como fogo e queime, e não haja quem [a] apague, \q por causa da maldade das obras de vocês.
pt.B: Circuncidem-se para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; circuncidem o coração, \q {{gender:povo|homens}} de Judá e habitantes de Jerusalém, \q senão a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira vai se acender como fogo e queimar, e ninguém vai apagá-la, \q por causa do mal que vocês fizeram.
pt.R: Circuncidem-se para pertencer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Circuncidem o coração: abram o coração para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, \q povo de Judá e de Jerusalém. \q Se não fizerem isso, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} ira vai se inflamar como fogo. Vai queimar, e ninguém vai conseguir apagá-la, \q por causa das coisas más que vocês fizeram.

am.L: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ተገረዙ፤ የልባችሁንም ሸለፈት አስወግዱ፤ \q እናንተ የይሁዳ ሰውና የኢየሩሳሌም ነዋሪዎች ሆይ፤ \q አለዚያ ቁጣዬ እንደ እሳት ይወጣል፤ ይነድዳልም፤ የሚያጠፋውም የለም፤ \q ስለ ሥራችሁ ክፋት።
am.B: {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ራሳችሁን ግረዙ፤ ልባችሁን ግረዙ፤ \q እናንተ የይሁዳ ሰዎችና የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ሆይ፤ \q አለዚያ ቁጣዬ እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል፤ ይቃጠላልም፤ ማንም አያጠፋውም፤ \q ስለ ሠራችሁት ክፋት።
am.R: {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} እንድትሆኑ ራሳችሁን ግረዙ። ልባችሁን ግረዙ፤ ልባችሁን ለእኔ ክፈቱ፤ \q እናንተ የይሁዳና የኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች። \q ይህን ባታደርጉ ቁጣዬ እንደ እሳት ይነድዳል። ይቃጠላል፤ ማንም ሊያጠፋው አይችልም፤ \q ስለ ሠራችኋቸው ክፉ ነገሮች።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अपना ख़तना करो, और अपने हृदय की खलड़ियाँ दूर करो, \q हे यहूदा के पुरुषो और यरूशलेम के निवासियो, \q नहीं तो मेरा क्रोध आग के समान भड़केगा, और जलेगा, और कोई [उसे] बुझानेवाला न होगा, \q तुम्हारे कामों की बुराई के कारण।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए अपना ख़तना करो; अपने हृदय का ख़तना करो, \q हे यहूदा के लोगो और यरूशलेम के लोगो, \q नहीं तो मेरा क्रोध आग की तरह भड़क उठेगा और जलेगा, और कोई उसे बुझा न सकेगा, \q उन बुरे कामों के कारण जो तुमने किए हैं।
hi.R: अपना ख़तना करो ताकि तुम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के हो जाओ। अपने हृदय का ख़तना करो: उसे मेरे लिए खोल दो, \q हे यहूदा और यरूशलेम के लोगो। \q यदि तुम ऐसा न करोगे, तो मेरा क्रोध आग की तरह भड़क उठेगा। वह जलता रहेगा, और कोई उसे बुझा न सकेगा, \q उन बुरे कामों के कारण जो तुमने किए हैं।

ru.L: Обрежьтесь для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} и удалите крайнюю плоть вашего сердца, \q муж Иуды и жители Иерусалима, \q чтобы не вышел, как огонь, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев и не разгорелся, и не будет гасящего, \q из-за зла ваших дел.
ru.B: Обрежьтесь для {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, обрежьте ваши сердца, \q жители Иуды и Иерусалима, \q иначе {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев вспыхнет, как огонь, и будет жечь, и никто не погасит его, \q из-за зла, которое вы делаете.
ru.R: Обрежьтесь, чтобы принадлежать {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}}. Обрежьте ваши сердца: откройте их для {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}, \q жители Иуды и Иерусалима. \q Если вы этого не сделаете, {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} гнев вспыхнет, как огонь. Он будет жечь, и никто не сможет его потушить, \q из-за злых дел, которые вы делаете.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のために割礼を受け、あなたがたの心の包皮を取り除け。 \q ユダの人とエルサレムに住む者たちよ。 \q さもないと、わたしの憤りが火のように燃え出て燃え上がり、消す者もない。 \q あなたがたの悪い行いのゆえに。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のために割礼を受け、心に割礼を施しなさい。 \q ユダの人々とエルサレムの住民よ。 \q さもないと、わたしの憤りが火のように燃え上がり、だれもそれを消すことができない。 \q あなたがたが行った悪のゆえに。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}のものとなるために、割礼を受けなさい。心に割礼を受けなさい。つまり、心をわたしに向かって開きなさい。 \q ユダとエルサレムの人々よ。 \q そうしないなら、わたしの怒りは火のように燃え上がる。それは燃え続け、だれも消すことはできない。 \q あなたたちが悪いことをしてきたからだ。

decisions.choice: remove the foreskins of your heart: the command of Deuteronomy 10:16
decisions.reason: Moses told Israel to "circumcise the foreskin of your heart" (Deuteronomy 10:16) and promised that the LORD would one day do it himself (Deuteronomy 30:6). Jeremiah repeats the command to a people who bear the sign in their bodies but not in their hearts (9:24-25).

decisions.choice: circumcise yourselves to the LORD: make the covenant sign true on the inside, belonging wholly to him
decisions.reason: Circumcision was the sign of the covenant on the body (Genesis 17:10-14). An uncircumcised heart is closed and unwilling to hear (Leviticus 26:41; Jeremiah 6:10 uses the same picture for the ear). To circumcise oneself "to the LORD" is to remove what closes the heart to him and to give oneself to him.

decisions.choice: my wrath will go out like fire, with no one to quench it: a judgment that cannot be stopped once it starts
decisions.reason: The same words return in 21:12 and Amos 5:6. A fire that no one can put out is a judgment that runs its course; the call to repent comes before it starts.

decisions.choice: circumcise your hearts
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the wording of Deuteronomy 10:16, which leaves out "foreskins" because "circumcise your hearts" already carries the picture. Literal keeps the full wording. Readable adds what it means, "open them to me", as Deuteronomy 10:16 does.

decisions.choice: people of Judah and (people of) Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the singular "man" and the word "inhabitants" mean everyone who lives there.

decisions.choice: "quiten los prepucios de su corazón" (L); "circunciden su corazón" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of Deuteronomy 10:16; Balanced and Readable use the shorter phrase, as the English levels do.

decisions.choice: magovi ya mioyo yenu (Literal); itahirini mioyo yenu (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The words of Deuteronomy 10:16 (meaning decision m1): "govi", foreskin, and "kutahiri", to circumcise, as the Pentateuch has them; the same wording returns at 9:25.

decisions.choice: "habitants" under the gender setting, "hommes" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The English "people of Judah" has the setting; French "habitants" is inclusive and pairs with "habitants de Jérusalem".

decisions.choice: "cắt bì lòng các ngươi" (Balanced, Readable)
alternatives: "cắt bỏ bao quy đầu của lòng"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew's "foreskins of your heart"; Balanced and Readable use the phrase "cắt bì lòng" of Deuteronomy 10:16 and Romans 2:29, and Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: os prepúcios do coração (L); circuncidem o coração (B, R); abram o coração para mim (R)
decisions.reason: The command is Deuteronomy 10:16's (m1), so each level takes that verse's Portuguese: Literal keeps "prepúcio", Balanced and Readable say "circuncidem o coração", and Readable explains it as Deuteronomy 10:16 does, with God speaking ("para mim"). 9:25 ("incircuncisos de coração") should use the same words.

decisions.choice: अपने हृदय की खलड़ियाँ दूर करो (L); अपने हृदय का ख़तना करो (B, R)
decisions.reason: The command of Deuteronomy 10:16, worded as it is there in this translation: Literal keeps the foreskins, Balanced and Readable say "circumcise your hearts"; Readable adds what that means, as Deuteronomy 10:16 does at Readable.

decisions.choice: удалите крайнюю плоть вашего сердца (L); обрежьте ваши сердца (B, R)
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 10:16 in this translation's Russian, as the Jeremiah note asks: Literal keeps the foreskin of the heart, Balanced and Readable say "circumcise your hearts".

decisions.choice: 'orlot levavkhem "心の包皮" (L), "心に割礼を施しなさい" (B), "心に割礼を受けなさい" (R), as the English per level and Deuteronomy 10:16; chamati "わたしの憤り" (L, B), "わたしの怒り" (R).
decisions.reason: The picture is kept; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable.

source.text: הַגִּ֣ידוּ בִֽיהוּדָ֗ה וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ הַשְׁמִ֔יעוּ וְאִמְר֕וּ תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בָּאָ֑רֶץ קִרְא֤וּ מַלְאוּ֙ וְאִמְר֔וּ הֵאָסְפ֥וּ וְנָב֖וֹאָה אֶל־עָרֵ֥י הַמִּבְצָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Declare in Judah, and in Jerusalem proclaim, and say: Blow [the] shofar in the land; call out, fill, and say: Gather yourselves and let us go into [the] cities of the fortification.

en.L: Declare in Judah, and in Jerusalem proclaim, and say, \q "Blow the trumpet in the land!" \q Cry out, [with] full [voice], and say, \q "Gather together, and let us go into the fortified cities!"
en.B: Announce it in Judah, proclaim it in Jerusalem, and say, \q "Blow the ram's horn throughout the land!" \q Shout at the top of your voice and say, \q "Gather together! Let us go into the fortified cities!"
en.R: Announce this in Judah and in Jerusalem. Tell them: \q "Blow the trumpet everywhere in the land!" \q Shout as loud as you can: \q "Come together! Let us run to the cities with strong walls!"

es.L: {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} en Judá, y en Jerusalén {{plural_you:proclamen|proclamad}}, y {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta en la tierra!». \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} a plena [voz] y {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Reúnanse|Reuníos}}, y entremos en las ciudades fortificadas!».
es.B: {{plural_you:Anúncienlo|Anunciadlo}} en Judá, {{plural_you:proclámenlo|proclamadlo}} en Jerusalén, y {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} el cuerno de carnero por todo el país!». \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} a voz en cuello y {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Reúnanse|Reuníos}}! ¡Entremos en las ciudades fortificadas!».
es.R: {{plural_you:Anuncien|Anunciad}} esto en Judá y en Jerusalén. {{plural_you:Díganles|Decidles}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} la trompeta por todo el país!». \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} con todas {{plural_you:sus fuerzas|vuestras fuerzas}}: \q «¡{{plural_you:Júntense|Juntaos}}! ¡Corramos a las ciudades con murallas fuertes!».

fr.L: Annoncez en Juda, et à Jérusalem publiez, et dites : \q « Sonnez du cor dans le pays ! » \q Criez à pleine [voix] et dites : \q « Rassemblez-vous, et entrons dans les villes fortifiées ! »
fr.B: Annoncez-le en Juda, publiez-le à Jérusalem, et dites : \q « Sonnez du cor dans tout le pays ! » \q Criez à pleine voix et dites : \q « Rassemblez-vous ! Allons dans les villes fortifiées ! »
fr.R: Annoncez ceci en Juda et à Jérusalem. Dites-leur : \q « Sonnez de la trompette partout dans le pays ! » \q Criez aussi fort que vous pouvez : \q « Rassemblez-vous ! Courons nous mettre à l’abri dans les villes aux murailles solides ! »

sw.L: Tangazeni katika Yuda, na katika Yerusalemu hubirini, mkaseme, \q "Pigeni baragumu katika nchi!" \q Pazeni sauti [kwa] nguvu, mkaseme, \q "Kusanyikeni, na tuingie katika miji yenye ngome!"
sw.B: Tangazeni katika Yuda, hubirini katika Yerusalemu, mseme, \q "Pigeni baragumu katika nchi yote!" \q Pigeni kelele kwa sauti kuu mkiseme, \q "Kusanyikeni! Tuingie katika miji yenye ngome!"
sw.R: Tangazeni jambo hili katika Yuda na katika Yerusalemu. Waambieni: \q "Pigeni baragumu kila mahali katika nchi!" \q Pigeni kelele kwa sauti yenu yote: \q "Kusanyikeni! Tukimbilie miji yenye kuta imara!"

vi.L: Hãy loan báo trong Giu-đa, và công bố trong Giê-ru-sa-lem, và nói: \q "Hãy thổi kèn trong xứ!" \q Hãy kêu lớn [tiếng] và nói: \q "Hãy tập hợp lại, và chúng ta hãy vào các thành kiên cố!"
vi.B: Hãy loan báo trong Giu-đa, hãy công bố trong Giê-ru-sa-lem, và nói: \q "Hãy thổi tù và khắp xứ!" \q Hãy kêu thật lớn và nói: \q "Hãy tập hợp lại! Chúng ta hãy vào các thành kiên cố!"
vi.R: Hãy loan báo điều này trong Giu-đa và trong Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hãy bảo họ: \q "Hãy thổi kèn khắp nơi trong xứ!" \q Hãy kêu lớn hết sức: \q "Hãy tụ họp lại! Chúng ta hãy chạy vào các thành có tường vững chắc!"

ko.L: 유다에 알리고 예루살렘에 선포하며 말하여라. \q "이 땅에 나팔을 불어라!" \q [목소리를] 가득히 외쳐 말하여라. \q "모여라. 우리가 요새화된 성읍들로 들어가자!"
ko.B: 유다에 알리고 예루살렘에 선포하며 말하여라. \q "온 땅에 숫양 뿔 나팔을 불어라!" \q 목청껏 외쳐 말하여라. \q "모여라! 견고한 성읍들로 들어가자!"
ko.R: 유다와 예루살렘에 이것을 알려라. 그들에게 말하여라. \q "온 땅에 나팔을 불어라!" \q 있는 힘을 다해 외쳐라. \q "함께 모여라! 성벽이 튼튼한 성읍들로 달려가자!"

pt.L: Anunciem em Judá, e em Jerusalém proclamem, e digam: \q "Toquem o chifre de carneiro na terra!" \q Gritem, enchendo [a voz], e digam: \q "Reúnam-se, e entremos nas cidades fortificadas!"
pt.B: Anunciem em Judá, proclamem em Jerusalém e digam: \q "Toquem o chifre de carneiro por toda a terra!" \q Gritem bem alto e digam: \q "Reúnam-se! Vamos entrar nas cidades fortificadas!"
pt.R: Anunciem isto em Judá e em Jerusalém. Digam ao povo: \q "Toquem a trombeta por toda a terra!" \q Gritem o mais alto que puderem: \q "Juntem-se! Vamos correr para as cidades de muros fortes!"

am.L: በይሁዳ ተናገሩ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አውሩ፤ እንዲህም በሉ፦ \q «በምድሪቱ መለከት ንፉ!» \q [በ]ሙሉ [ድምፅ] ጩኹ፤ እንዲህም በሉ፦ \q «ተሰብሰቡ፤ ወደ ተመሸጉትም ከተሞች እንግባ!»
am.B: በይሁዳ አስታውቁ፤ በኢየሩሳሌም አውጁ፤ እንዲህም በሉ፦ \q «በምድሪቱ ሁሉ የቀንድ መለከት ንፉ!» \q በታላቅ ድምፅ ጩኹ፤ እንዲህም በሉ፦ \q «ተሰብሰቡ! ወደ ተመሸጉት ከተሞች እንግባ!»
am.R: ይህን በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም አስታውቁ። እንዲህ በሏቸው፦ \q «በምድሪቱ በየስፍራው መለከት ንፉ!» \q የቻላችሁትን ያህል ጩኹ፦ \q «ኑ፣ ተሰብሰቡ! ጠንካራ ቅጥር ወዳላቸው ከተሞች እንሩጥ!»

hi.L: यहूदा में बताओ, और यरूशलेम में सुनाओ, और कहो, \q "देश में नरसिंगा फूँको!" \q पुकारो, [पूरे गले से], और कहो, \q "इकट्ठे हो जाओ, और हम गढ़वाले नगरों में चलें!"
hi.B: यहूदा में इसकी घोषणा करो, यरूशलेम में इसे सुनाओ, और कहो, \q "सारे देश में नरसिंगा फूँको!" \q ऊँचे स्वर से पुकारकर कहो, \q "इकट्ठे हो जाओ! आओ, हम गढ़वाले नगरों में चलें!"
hi.R: यहूदा और यरूशलेम में यह सुना दो। उनसे कहो: \q "देश में हर जगह नरसिंगा फूँको!" \q जितनी ज़ोर से हो सके, पुकारो: \q "इकट्ठे हो जाओ! आओ, हम मज़बूत शहरपनाहवाले नगरों में भाग चलें!"

ru.L: Возвестите в Иуде, и в Иерусалиме провозгласите, и скажите: \q «Трубите в трубу по земле!» \q Кричите [во весь] голос и скажите: \q «Соберитесь, и пойдём в укреплённые города!»
ru.B: Объявите в Иуде, провозгласите в Иерусалиме и скажите: \q «Трубите в рог по всей земле!» \q Кричите во весь голос и скажите: \q «Соберитесь! Пойдём в укреплённые города!»
ru.R: Объявите это в Иуде и в Иерусалиме. Скажите им: \q «Трубите в трубу по всей земле!» \q Кричите изо всех сил: \q «Собирайтесь! Бежим в города с крепкими стенами!»

ja.L: ユダで告げ、エルサレムで聞かせて、言え。 \q 「国中で角笛を吹け！」 \q 大声で叫んで、言え。 \q 「集まれ。要塞の町々に入ろう！」
ja.B: ユダに告げ知らせ、エルサレムに触れ回って、言いなさい。 \q 「国中で角笛を吹き鳴らせ！」 \q 声を限りに叫んで、言いなさい。 \q 「集まれ！堅固な町々に逃げ込もう！」
ja.R: ユダとエルサレムに知らせなさい。人々にこう告げなさい。 \q 「国中で角笛を吹け！」 \q できる限りの大声で叫びなさい。 \q 「集まれ！強い城壁のある町々へ逃げ込もう！」

decisions.choice: the shofar blown in the land: the alarm for an enemy attack
decisions.reason: The shofar, a ram's horn, was blown to warn of an enemy and to call people to arms or to shelter (6:1; Hosea 5:8; Amos 3:6). Here it warns of the invader of verses 6-7.

decisions.choice: call out, fill: cry with a full voice
decisions.reason: The two verbs stand side by side with no object. "Fill" means fill the voice: shout loudly. The heralds are to cry the warning as loud as they can (12:6 has "they call after you fully").

decisions.choice: fortified cities: walled towns where people from the open country took refuge
decisions.reason: When an army invaded, people left their villages and fields for the walled towns (8:14; 35:11). The cry shows that the danger is close.

decisions.choice: the LORD sends heralds through the land; what they are to cry is quoted
decisions.reason: The commands are plural: heralds are told to spread the alarm. The words of the alarm itself, "Blow ..." and "Gather ...", are what they are to say.

decisions.choice: trumpet (L, R); ram's horn (B)
decisions.reason: The book-wide choice for the shofar, as in Isaiah: Literal and Readable say "trumpet", Balanced "ram's horn" (m1).

decisions.choice: cities with strong walls
decisions.reason: Readable says what made a city "fortified" (m3).

decisions.choice: "trompeta" (L, R); "cuerno de carnero" (B)
decisions.reason: As the English levels: Balanced names the ram's horn, Literal and Readable use the familiar word. The cries quoted for the heralds are plural commands and take the plural you setting too.

decisions.choice: baragumu
decisions.reason: The shofar is "baragumu", the horn trumpet, at every level, as the published 1 Chronicles 15:28 distinguishes it from the metal "tarumbeta"; the English levels vary between "trumpet" and "ram's horn".

decisions.choice: "le cor" (L, B); "la trompette" (R), for the shofar in the whole book
decisions.reason: "Sonner du cor" is the French Samuel's wording for the shofar (1 Samuel 13:3); Readable uses the more familiar "trompette", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "kèn" (Literal, Readable); "tù và" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The shofar was a ram's horn; Balanced names it as a horn ("tù và"), as the English Balanced does, while Literal and Readable use the plain word for a trumpet. Kept so through the chapter.

decisions.choice: 나팔 (Literal, Readable); 숫양 뿔 나팔 (Balanced)
decisions.reason: As the English, Balanced says what the *shofar* was; the other levels use the common word.

decisions.choice: o chifre de carneiro (L, B); a trombeta (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the shofar is "chifre de carneiro" at Literal and Balanced, naming the instrument as Exodus 19:13 and Isaiah 18:3 do in Portuguese, and "trombeta" at Readable wherever the English Readable says "trumpet".

decisions.choice: "መለከት" (Literal, Readable); "የቀንድ መለከት" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The ram's horn (shofar) keeps the wording settled for Kings and Chronicles; 4:19 and 4:21 follow it.

decisions.choice: नरसिंगा
decisions.reason: The shofar is नरसिंगा at every level, as Isaiah 18:3 and the Psalms forms have it; the one Hindi word serves both the English "trumpet" and "ram's horn". Book-wide choice.

decisions.choice: труба (L, R); рог (B)
decisions.reason: The shofar in the wording Isaiah has in this translation: труба at Literal and Readable, рог at Balanced.

decisions.choice: shofar "角笛" at every level, as Isaiah 27:13 and Hosea 5:8 (the English L and R say trumpet); the cries of alarm are bare imperatives at every level, as the war cries of Isaiah 21; 'arei hammivtsar "要塞の町々" (L), "堅固な町々" (B), "強い城壁のある町々" (R), as 1:18.
decisions.reason: One word for the shofar through the prophets; a reviewer may follow the English per level as Hosea 8:1 did.

source.text: שְׂאוּ־נֵ֣ס צִיּ֔וֹנָה הָעִ֖יזוּ אַֽל־תַּעֲמֹ֑דוּ כִּ֣י רָעָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא מִצָּפ֖וֹן וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּדֽוֹל׃

records.literal_gloss: Lift up a signal flag toward Zion; flee for safety, do not stand still, for evil I am bringing from [the] north, and great destruction.

en.L: Lift up a signal flag toward Zion; \q flee for safety, do not stand still! \q For evil I am bringing from the north, and a great breaking.
en.B: Raise a signal flag toward Zion! \q Run for safety; do not wait! \q For I am bringing disaster from the north, a great and crushing ruin.
en.R: Put up a signal flag that points the way to Zion! \q Run for safety! Do not wait! \q For I am bringing disaster from the north. It will crush everything.

es.L: {{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} bandera hacia Sion; \q ¡{{plural_you:huyan para salvarse, no se detengan|huid para salvaros, no os detengáis}}! \q Porque yo traigo del norte el mal, y un gran quebranto.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Alcen|Alzad}} una bandera hacia Sion! \q ¡{{plural_you:Corran a ponerse|Corred a poneros}} a salvo; no {{plural_you:esperen|esperéis}}! \q Porque yo traigo del norte la desgracia, una ruina grande y aplastante.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} una bandera que señale el camino a Sion! \q ¡{{plural_you:Corran a ponerse|Corred a poneros}} a salvo! ¡No {{plural_you:esperen|esperéis}}! \q Porque yo traigo la desgracia desde el norte. Lo aplastará todo.

fr.L: Élevez un étendard vers Sion ; \q fuyez pour vous mettre à l’abri, ne vous arrêtez pas ! \q Car je fais venir du nord le malheur, et un grand désastre.
fr.B: Dressez un étendard vers Sion ! \q Fuyez pour vous mettre à l’abri ; n’attendez pas ! \q Car je fais venir du nord le malheur, une ruine immense qui écrase tout.
fr.R: Plantez un drapeau qui montre le chemin de Sion ! \q Courez vous mettre à l’abri ! N’attendez pas ! \q Car je fais venir du nord le malheur. Il va tout écraser.

sw.L: Inueni bendera kuelekea Sayuni; \q kimbieni mpate salama, msisimame! \q Kwa maana ninaleta mabaya kutoka kaskazini, na uvunjifu mkuu.
sw.B: Inueni bendera kuelekea Sayuni! \q Kimbieni mpate usalama; msingoje! \q Kwa maana ninaleta maafa kutoka kaskazini, maangamizi makuu yanayoponda.
sw.R: Wekeni bendera inayoonyesha njia ya kwenda Sayuni! \q Kimbieni mpate usalama! Msingoje! \q Kwa maana ninaleta maafa kutoka kaskazini. Yataponda kila kitu.

vi.L: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu hướng về Si-ôn; \q hãy chạy trốn cho an toàn, đừng đứng lại! \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đem tai họa đến từ phương bắc, và một sự đổ vỡ lớn.
vi.B: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu hướng về Si-ôn! \q Hãy chạy tìm nơi an toàn; đừng chần chờ! \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang đem tai họa đến từ phương bắc, một sự tàn phá lớn lao khủng khiếp.
vi.R: Hãy dựng cờ hiệu chỉ đường về Si-ôn! \q Hãy chạy đến nơi an toàn! Đừng chần chờ! \q Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đang đem tai họa đến từ phương bắc. Nó sẽ nghiền nát mọi thứ.

ko.L: 시온을 향해 깃발을 올려라. \q 피하여라, 멈춰 서지 마라! \q 내가 북쪽에서 재앙과 큰 파멸을 가져오기 때문이다.
ko.B: 시온을 향해 신호 깃발을 세워라! \q 피하여라. 머뭇거리지 마라! \q 내가 북쪽에서 재앙을, 크고 무서운 파멸을 가져오고 있다.
ko.R: 시온으로 가는 길을 알리는 깃발을 세워라! \q 피하여라! 머뭇거리지 마라! \q 내가 북쪽에서 재앙을 가져오고 있다. 그것이 모든 것을 부술 것이다.

pt.L: Levantem uma bandeira em direção a Sião; \q fujam para se salvar, não fiquem parados! \q Pois eu estou trazendo do norte o mal, e uma grande ruptura.
pt.B: Ergam uma bandeira de sinal na direção de Sião! \q Corram para se salvar; não esperem! \q Pois estou trazendo do norte a desgraça, uma ruína grande e esmagadora.
pt.R: Ponham uma bandeira mostrando o caminho para Sião! \q Corram para se salvar! Não esperem! \q Pois estou trazendo uma desgraça do norte. Ela vai esmagar tudo.

am.L: ወደ ጽዮን ዓርማ አንሡ፤ \q ለደኅንነታችሁ ሽሹ፤ አትቁሙ! \q እኔ ከሰሜን ክፉ ነገርንና ታላቅ ስብራትን አመጣለሁና።
am.B: ወደ ጽዮን የሚያመለክት ዓርማ አቁሙ! \q ለሕይወታችሁ ሽሹ፤ አትዘግዩ! \q እኔ ከሰሜን መከራን፣ ታላቅና የሚያደቅቅ ጥፋትን አመጣለሁና።
am.R: ወደ ጽዮን የሚወስደውን መንገድ የሚያሳይ ዓርማ አቁሙ! \q ለሕይወታችሁ ሽሹ! አትዘግዩ! \q እኔ ከሰሜን መከራን አመጣለሁና። ሁሉን ያደቅቃል።

hi.L: सिय्योन की ओर संकेत का झंडा खड़ा करो; \q शरण के लिए भागो, ठहरो मत! \q क्योंकि मैं उत्तर से बुराई, और बड़ा विनाश ला रहा हूँ।
hi.B: सिय्योन की ओर संकेत का झंडा खड़ा करो! \q जान बचाकर भागो; देर मत करो! \q क्योंकि मैं उत्तर से विपत्ति ला रहा हूँ, बड़ा और कुचल देनेवाला विनाश।
hi.R: ऐसा झंडा खड़ा करो जो सिय्योन का रास्ता दिखाए! \q जान बचाकर भागो! देर मत करो! \q क्योंकि मैं उत्तर से विपत्ति ला रहा हूँ। वह सब कुछ कुचल डालेगी।

ru.L: Поднимите знамя к Сиону; \q бегите, не останавливайтесь! \q Ведь зло {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу с севера и великое крушение.
ru.B: Поднимите знамя к Сиону! \q Бегите в безопасное место, не медлите! \q Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу с севера бедствие, великое и сокрушительное разорение.
ru.R: Поставьте знамя, которое покажет дорогу к Сиону! \q Бегите в безопасное место! Не медлите! \q Ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} навожу с севера беду. Она сокрушит всё.

ja.L: シオンに向けて旗を掲げよ。 \q 逃げよ、立ち止まるな！ \q わたしが北から災いと大いなる破滅をもたらすからだ。
ja.B: シオンを指して合図の旗を掲げなさい！ \q 逃げなさい。ぐずぐずしてはならない！ \q わたしが北から災いをもたらすからだ。すべてを打ち砕く大きな破滅を。
ja.R: シオンへの道を示す合図の旗を立てなさい！ \q 逃げなさい！ぐずぐずしてはいけない！ \q わたしが北から災いをもたらすからだ。それは、すべてを打ち砕く。

decisions.choice: a signal flag toward Zion: a banner on a pole showing refugees the way to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: A signal flag was raised on a pole or a hilltop to call people together or show them where to go (Isaiah 5:26; 11:12). Here it points the people of the countryside to Zion, Jerusalem, as the place of refuge.

decisions.choice: evil: disaster, harm
decisions.reason: The word means what is bad, whether wrongdoing or the harm that comes on people. Here it is the disaster the LORD brings as judgment, not wrongdoing on his part (as in Isaiah 45:7; Jeremiah 1:14).

decisions.choice: from the north: the invader foretold in Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: In 1:13-15 disaster boils over "from the north". The enemy is not named in these chapters (6:1, 22); later it is named as Babylon under Nebuchadnezzar (20:4; 25:9). Armies from Mesopotamia came into Israel from the north, along the curve of fertile land.

decisions.choice: great destruction: a great breaking, a crash
decisions.reason: The word means breaking or fracture, as of a bone or a wall. It returns in verse 20 and through the book for the collapse of the nation (6:1; 8:21; 14:17).

decisions.choice: a great and crushing ruin / It will crush everything
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the picture of breaking in "destruction" (m4).

decisions.choice: "bandera"
decisions.reason: The signal flag (nes) is "bandera" at every level, as the terms note sets it.

decisions.choice: "un étendard" (L, B); "un drapeau" (R), for *nes* in the whole book
decisions.reason: The settled French wording for the signal flag in the prophets.

decisions.choice: "cờ hiệu"
decisions.reason: The terms note's word for the signal flag (nes), at every level.

decisions.choice: "ዓርማ" for the signal flag
decisions.reason: The banner raised on a pole (nes) is "ዓርማ", a standard or flag, rather than the general word for a sign.

decisions.choice: nes "旗" (L), "合図の旗" (B, R), as Isaiah; ra'ah "災い" at every level (m2), as 1:14; shever gadol "大いなる破滅" (L), "大きな破滅" (B).
decisions.reason: The prophetic convention for nes; "evil" as calamity is 災い.

source.text: עָלָ֤ה אַרְיֵה֙ מִֽסֻּבְּכ֔וֹ וּמַשְׁחִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם נָסַ֖ע יָצָ֣א מִמְּקֹמ֑וֹ לָשׂ֤וּם אַרְצֵךְ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה עָרַ֥יִךְ תִּצֶּ֖ינָה מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: Has gone up a lion from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations has set out; he has gone out from his place to make your land a waste; your cities will be laid in ruins, without inhabitant.

en.L: A lion has come up from his thicket, \q and a destroyer of nations has set out; \q he has gone out from his place \q to make your land a waste; \q your cities will fall in ruins, without inhabitant.
en.B: A lion has left his thicket; \q a destroyer of nations has broken camp. \q He has left his place \q to make your land a wasteland. \q Your towns will lie in ruins, with no one living in them.
en.R: A lion has come out of the bushes where it hides. \q One who destroys nations is on the march. \q He has left his home \q to turn your land into a wasteland. \q Your towns will be ruins, and no one will live in them.

es.L: Ha subido el león de su espesura, \q y el destructor de naciones se ha puesto en marcha; \q ha salido de su lugar \q para convertir tu tierra en desolación; \q tus ciudades quedarán en ruinas, sin habitante.
es.B: Un león ha dejado su espesura; \q un destructor de naciones ha levantado el campamento. \q Ha salido de su lugar \q para convertir tu tierra en un desierto. \q Tus ciudades quedarán en ruinas, sin nadie que viva en ellas.
es.R: Un león ha salido de los matorrales donde se esconde. \q Uno que destruye naciones está en marcha. \q Ha salido de su casa \q para convertir tu tierra en un desierto. \q Tus ciudades serán ruinas, y nadie vivirá en ellas.

fr.L: Un lion est monté de son fourré, \q et un destructeur des nations s’est mis en route ; \q il est sorti de son lieu \q pour faire de ton pays une désolation ; \q tes villes seront ruinées, sans habitant.
fr.B: Le lion a quitté son fourré ; \q le destructeur des nations a levé le camp. \q Il est sorti de chez lui \q pour faire de ton pays un désert. \q Tes villes seront en ruine, et personne n’y habitera.
fr.R: Un lion est sorti des buissons où il se cache. \q Celui qui détruit les nations est en marche. \q Il a quitté son pays \q pour faire de ton pays un désert. \q Tes villes ne seront plus que des ruines, et personne n’y habitera.

sw.L: Simba amepanda kutoka kichakani mwake, \q naye mwangamizaji wa mataifa ameondoka; \q ametoka mahali pake \q aifanye nchi yako kuwa ukiwa; \q miji yako itaanguka kuwa magofu, bila mkaaji.
sw.B: Simba ametoka kichakani mwake; \q mwangamizaji wa mataifa ameng'oa kambi yake. \q Ameondoka mahali pake \q ili aifanye nchi yako kuwa jangwa. \q Miji yako itakuwa magofu, bila mtu wa kuishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Simba ametoka vichakani anakojificha. \q Yeye anayeangamiza mataifa yuko safarini. \q Ameondoka nyumbani kwake \q ili aigeuze nchi yako kuwa jangwa. \q Miji yako itakuwa magofu, wala hakuna mtu atakayeishi humo.

vi.L: Sư tử đã lên khỏi bụi rậm nó, \q kẻ hủy diệt các dân tộc đã lên đường; \q nó đã ra khỏi chỗ ở mình \q để làm cho xứ ngươi thành hoang phế; \q các thành ngươi sẽ đổ nát, không có dân cư.
vi.B: Sư tử đã rời bụi rậm của nó; \q kẻ hủy diệt các dân tộc đã nhổ trại. \q Nó đã rời chỗ ở mình \q để biến xứ ngươi thành hoang mạc. \q Các thành của ngươi sẽ đổ nát, không còn ai ở.
vi.R: Sư tử đã ra khỏi bụi rậm nơi nó ẩn mình. \q Kẻ hủy diệt các dân tộc đang tiến quân. \q Nó đã rời chỗ ở của nó \q để biến xứ ngươi thành đất hoang. \q Các thành của ngươi sẽ chỉ còn là đống đổ nát, và không ai sống ở đó nữa.

ko.L: 사자가 자기 덤불에서 올라왔고, \q 민족들을 멸하는 자가 길을 떠났다. \q 그가 자기 처소에서 나왔다. \q 네 땅을 황무지로 만들려고. \q 네 성읍들은 폐허가 되어 주민이 없을 것이다.
ko.B: 사자가 덤불에서 뛰쳐나왔다. \q 민족들을 멸하는 자가 진을 걷고 떠났다. \q 그가 자기 처소를 떠났다. \q 네 땅을 황무지로 만들려는 것이다. \q 네 성읍들은 폐허가 되어 사는 사람이 없을 것이다.
ko.R: 사자가 숨어 있던 덤불에서 나왔다. \q 나라들을 멸하는 자가 진군해 오고 있다. \q 그가 자기 집을 떠났다. \q 네 땅을 황무지로 만들려는 것이다. \q 네 성읍들은 폐허가 되고, 아무도 그곳에 살지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Um leão subiu do seu matagal, \q e um destruidor de nações partiu; \q ele saiu do seu lugar \q para fazer da tua terra uma desolação; \q as tuas cidades cairão em ruínas, sem habitante.
pt.B: Um leão deixou o seu matagal; \q um destruidor de nações levantou acampamento. \q Ele saiu do seu lugar \q para fazer da tua terra um deserto. \q As tuas cidades ficarão em ruínas, sem ninguém morando nelas.
pt.R: Um leão saiu do mato onde se esconde. \q Alguém que destrói nações está em marcha. \q Ele saiu da sua casa \q para fazer da tua terra um deserto. \q As tuas cidades vão ficar em ruínas, e ninguém vai morar nelas.

am.L: አንበሳ ከደኑ ወጥቷል፤ \q የሕዝቦችም አጥፊ ተነሥቷል፤ \q ከስፍራው ወጥቷል፤ \q ምድርሽን ባድማ ሊያደርግ፤ \q ከተሞችሽም ፈርሰው ይቀራሉ፤ የሚኖርባቸውም አይኖርም።
am.B: አንበሳ ከጫካው ወጥቷል፤ \q የሕዝቦች አጥፊ ሰፈሩን ነቅሎ ተነሥቷል። \q ስፍራውን ትቶ ወጥቷል፤ \q ምድርሽን ምድረ በዳ ሊያደርግ። \q ከተሞችሽ ፈራርሰው ይቀራሉ፤ የሚኖርባቸውም አይገኝም።
am.R: አንበሳ ከተደበቀበት ጫካ ወጥቷል። \q ሕዝቦችን የሚያጠፋው ጉዞ ጀምሯል። \q ቤቱን ትቶ ወጥቷል፤ \q ምድርሽን ምድረ በዳ ሊያደርግ። \q ከተሞችሽ ፍርስራሽ ይሆናሉ፤ በእነርሱም የሚኖር አይኖርም።

hi.L: एक सिंह अपनी झाड़ी से निकल आया है, \q और जातियों का नाश करनेवाला चल पड़ा है; \q वह अपने स्थान से निकला है \q कि तुम्हारे देश को उजाड़ बना दे; \q तुम्हारे नगर खंडहर हो जाएँगे, कोई निवासी न रहेगा।
hi.B: एक सिंह अपनी झाड़ी से निकल आया है; \q देशों का नाश करनेवाला डेरा उठाकर चल पड़ा है। \q वह अपने स्थान से निकल पड़ा है \q कि तुम्हारे देश को उजाड़ दे। \q तुम्हारे नगर खंडहर पड़े रहेंगे, उनमें कोई न रहेगा।
hi.R: एक सिंह उन झाड़ियों से निकल आया है जहाँ वह छिपा रहता है। \q देशों को नाश करनेवाला चल पड़ा है। \q वह अपना घर छोड़कर निकला है \q कि तुम्हारे देश को उजाड़ दे। \q तुम्हारे नगर खंडहर हो जाएँगे, और उनमें कोई नहीं रहेगा।

ru.L: Поднялся лев из своей чащи, \q и губитель народов выступил; \q он вышел из своего места, \q чтобы сделать твою землю пустыней; \q твои города будут разрушены, без жителя.
ru.B: Лев покинул свою чащу; \q губитель народов снялся с места. \q Он вышел из своего места, \q чтобы превратить твою землю в пустыню. \q Твои города будут лежать в развалинах, и никто не будет в них жить.
ru.R: Лев вышел из кустов, где он прячется. \q Тот, кто уничтожает народы, выступил в поход. \q Он покинул свой дом, \q чтобы превратить твою землю в пустыню. \q Твои города станут развалинами, и никто не будет в них жить.

ja.L: 獅子がその茂みから上って来た。 \q 国々を滅ぼす者が出発した。 \q 彼は自分の所から出て来た。 \q あなたの地を荒れ地とするために。 \q あなたの町々は廃虚となり、住む者もなくなる。
ja.B: 獅子が茂みを出た。 \q 国々を滅ぼす者が陣を払った。 \q 彼は自分の所を出て来た。 \q あなたの地を荒れ果てた地にするために。 \q あなたの町々は廃虚となり、住む者はいなくなる。
ja.R: ライオンが、隠れていた茂みから出て来た。 \q 国々を滅ぼす者が進軍を始めた。 \q 彼は自分の国を出て来た。 \q あなたの土地を荒れ地にするためだ。 \q あなたの町々は廃虚になり、だれも住まなくなる。

decisions.choice: a lion ... a destroyer of nations: the invading king and his army
decisions.reason: The lion is a picture of the enemy from the north (verse 6), who leaves his lair to hunt (2:15; 5:6; 50:17, where the lion is named as the king of Babylon). "Destroyer of nations" says plainly what the lion is.

decisions.choice: set out: pulled up the tent pegs, broke camp
decisions.reason: The verb is used for breaking camp and moving on (Genesis 35:5; Numbers 10:12). The army is already on the move.

decisions.choice: a waste ... laid in ruins: the land made desolate, the towns emptied
decisions.reason: The first word means a place so ruined that people are appalled at it (2:15; 5:30). The second verb means to be laid waste, to fall in ruins; with "without inhabitant" it pictures towns left empty.

decisions.choice: the bushes where it hides
decisions.reason: Readable explains "thicket", the dense undergrowth where a lion lies hidden.

decisions.choice: 'aryeh "獅子" (L, B), "ライオン" (R); the invader is "彼" (a human king), never for God; mashchit goyim "国々を滅ぼす者".
decisions.reason: The prophetic convention for lions; Jerusalem is "あなた".

source.text: עַל־זֹ֛את חִגְר֥וּ שַׂקִּ֖ים סִפְד֣וּ וְהֵילִ֑ילוּ כִּ֥י לֹא־שָׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Because of this put on sackcloth, lament and wail, for not has turned back [the] burning of [the] anger of Yahweh from us.

en.L: Because of this, gird on sackcloth, lament and wail; \q for the burning anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has not turned back from us.
en.B: So dress in sackcloth, lament and wail, \q for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s fierce anger has still not turned away from us.
en.R: So put on rough clothes to show your sorrow. Mourn and cry out in grief! \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is still burning with anger against us. It has not turned away from us.

es.L: Por esto, {{plural_you:cíñanse|ceñíos}} de cilicio, {{plural_you:lamenten y giman|lamentad y gemid}}; \q porque el ardor de la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} no se ha apartado de nosotros.
es.B: Por eso, {{plural_you:vístanse|vestíos}} de cilicio, {{plural_you:lamenten y giman|lamentad y gemid}}, \q porque la ardiente ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} todavía no se ha apartado de nosotros.
es.R: Por eso, {{plural_you:vístanse|vestíos}} con ropa áspera de luto. ¡{{plural_you:Lloren y giman|Llorad y gemid}} de tristeza! \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sigue ardiendo de ira contra nosotros. Su enojo no se ha apartado de nosotros.

fr.L: À cause de cela, ceignez-vous de sacs, lamentez-vous et hurlez ; \q car l’ardeur de la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne s’est pas détournée de nous.
fr.B: Alors, habillez-vous de sacs, lamentez-vous et gémissez, \q car l’ardente colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ne s’est toujours pas détournée de nous.
fr.R: Alors, mettez des vêtements de deuil grossiers pour montrer votre tristesse. Pleurez et criez votre douleur ! \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est toujours en colère contre nous. Sa colère ne s’est pas détournée de nous.

sw.L: Kwa sababu ya hili jifungeni nguo za magunia, ombolezeni na kupiga yowe; \q kwa maana hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} haijarudi nyuma kutoka kwetu.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo vaeni nguo za magunia, ombolezeni na kulia kwa sauti, \q kwa maana hasira kali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} bado haijatuacha.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo vaeni nguo za magunia kuonyesha huzuni yenu. Ombolezeni na kulia kwa uchungu! \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} bado anawaka hasira juu yetu. Hasira yake haijatuacha.

vi.L: Vì thế, hãy thắt vải thô, than khóc và kêu gào; \q vì cơn giận nóng cháy của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chưa quay khỏi chúng ta.
vi.B: Vậy hãy mặc vải thô, than khóc và kêu gào, \q vì cơn giận dữ dội của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn chưa lìa khỏi chúng ta.
vi.R: Vậy hãy mặc vải thô để tỏ lòng buồn rầu. Hãy than khóc và kêu gào! \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vẫn còn nổi giận phừng phừng với chúng ta. Cơn giận ấy chưa lìa khỏi chúng ta.

ko.L: 이 때문에 굵은 베를 두르고 슬퍼하며 울부짖어라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 타오르는 분노가 우리에게서 돌이켜지지 않았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러니 굵은 베옷을 입고 슬퍼하며 통곡하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 맹렬한 분노가 아직도 우리에게서 떠나지 않았다.
ko.R: 그러니 슬픔을 나타내는 거친 베옷을 입어라. 슬퍼하며 소리 내어 울어라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아직도 우리에게 몹시 노하고 계신다. 그 분노가 우리에게서 떠나지 않았다.

pt.L: Por isso, cinjam-se de pano de saco, lamentem e gemam; \q pois o ardor da ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} não se desviou de nós.
pt.B: Por isso, vistam pano de saco, lamentem e chorem alto, \q pois a ira ardente {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ainda não se afastou de nós.
pt.R: Por isso, vistam roupas ásperas para mostrar a sua tristeza. Chorem e gritem de dor! \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ainda está ardendo de ira contra nós. A {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira não se afastou de nós.

am.L: ስለዚህ ማቅ ታጠቁ፤ አልቅሱ፤ ዋይ ዋይም በሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} የሚነድድ ቁጣ ከእኛ አልተመለሰምና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ማቅ ልበሱ፤ አልቅሱ፤ ዋይ ዋይም በሉ፤ \q {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ጽኑ ቁጣ እስካሁን ከእኛ አልራቀምና።
am.R: ስለዚህ ሐዘናችሁን ለማሳየት ሻካራ ልብስ ልበሱ። አልቅሱ፤ በሐዘንም ጩኹ! \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አሁንም በእኛ ላይ በቁጣ እየነደደ ነው። ቁጣው ከእኛ አልራቀም።

hi.L: इस कारण टाट बाँधो, शोक करो और हाय-हाय करो; \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भड़का हुआ क्रोध हम पर से नहीं हटा।
hi.B: इसलिए टाट पहनो, शोक करो और विलाप करो, \q क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भड़का हुआ क्रोध अब तक हम पर से नहीं हटा।
hi.R: इसलिए अपना दुख दिखाने के लिए खुरदरा टाट पहनो। शोक मनाओ और दुख से रोओ! \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का क्रोध अब भी हम पर भड़का हुआ है। वह हम पर से नहीं हटा।

ru.L: Из-за этого препояшьтесь вретищем, плачьте и рыдайте, \q ведь не отвратился от нас пылающий гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Поэтому оденьтесь во вретище, плачьте и рыдайте, \q ведь пылающий гнев {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} всё ещё не отвратился от нас.
ru.R: Поэтому наденьте грубую одежду в знак скорби. Плачьте и рыдайте от горя! \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} всё ещё пылает гневом на нас. Его гнев не отвратился от нас.

ja.L: このために、粗布を身にまとい、嘆き、泣きわめけ。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の燃える怒りが、わたしたちから去っていないからだ。
ja.B: だから、粗布をまとい、嘆き、泣き叫びなさい。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の激しい怒りが、まだわたしたちから去っていないからだ。
ja.R: だから、悲しみを表す粗い布の服を着なさい。嘆き、悲しんで大声で泣きなさい！ \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は今も、わたしたちに対して燃えるように怒っておられる。その怒りは、わたしたちから去っていない。

decisions.choice: put on sackcloth: dress in mourning
decisions.reason: Sackcloth was rough cloth of goat hair, tied around the waist in times of grief, repentance or disaster (6:26; Genesis 37:34; Isaiah 22:12).

decisions.choice: the burning of the anger of the LORD: his fierce anger
decisions.reason: The word for anger also means "nose", from the flaring nostrils of an angry person; with "burning" it describes anger at its height (verse 26; 25:37; Exodus 32:12).

decisions.choice: us: the prophet speaks as one of the people
decisions.reason: The prophet calls the people to mourn and counts himself among those under God's anger, as he does again in verse 13.

decisions.choice: rough clothes to show your sorrow ... cry out in grief
decisions.reason: Readable explains what sackcloth was for (m1) and uses the book-wide Readable wording "cry out in grief" for "wail", as Isaiah does.

decisions.choice: "cilicio" (L, B); "ropa áspera de luto" (R)
decisions.reason: Sackcloth is "cilicio" as the Samuel terms note sets it; Readable says what it was and why it was worn, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "vải thô" (every level)
decisions.reason: Sackcloth is "vải thô" at every level, the published word (2 Kings 19:1-2) and the form used across Isaiah and Jeremiah; Readable adds the reason, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: टाट बाँधो (L); टाट पहनो (B); खुरदरा टाट पहनो (R)
decisions.reason: Sackcloth is टाट, as Isaiah 15:3 in this translation; Readable adds खुरदरा and the reason it was worn, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: вретище (L, B); грубая одежда в знак скорби (R)
decisions.reason: Sackcloth in the traditional word at Literal and Balanced; Readable says what it was for, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: saq "粗布" (L, B), "粗い布の服" (R); heililu "泣きわめけ" (L), "泣き叫びなさい" (B), "悲しんで大声で泣きなさい" (R), as Isaiah 13:6; charon 'af YHWH "{D}の燃える怒り" (L), "激しい怒り" (B), R with the light respect form "怒っておられる" since the prophet speaks (m3).
decisions.reason: The Isaiah forms; the prophet speaks as one of the people here.

source.text: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה יֹאבַ֥ד לֵב־הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְלֵ֣ב הַשָּׂרִ֑ים וְנָשַׁ֨מּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים וְהַנְּבִיאִ֖ים יִתְמָֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be in the day that, declares Yahweh, will perish [the] heart of the king and [the] heart of the officials, and will be appalled the priests, and the prophets will be astounded.

en.L: And it will be in that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [that] the heart of the king will fail, and the heart of the princes; \q and the priests will be appalled, \q and the prophets will be astounded.
en.B: On that day, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the king and the officials will lose heart; \q the priests will be horrified, \q and the prophets will be stunned.
en.R: At that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q the king and his leaders will lose their courage. \q The priests will be shocked, \q and the prophets will be stunned.

es.L: Y sucederá en aquel día, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q [que] desfallecerá el corazón del rey y el corazón de los príncipes; \q y los sacerdotes quedarán espantados, \q y los profetas, atónitos.
es.B: Aquel día, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q el rey y los jefes perderán el valor; \q los sacerdotes se horrorizarán, \q y los profetas quedarán pasmados.
es.R: En ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q el rey y sus líderes perderán el valor. \q Los sacerdotes quedarán impactados, \q y los profetas, pasmados.

fr.L: Et il arrivera en ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q que le cœur du roi défaillira, et le cœur des princes ; \q et les prêtres seront consternés, \q et les prophètes seront stupéfaits.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q le roi et les chefs perdront courage ; \q les prêtres seront saisis d’horreur, \q et les prophètes resteront stupéfaits.
fr.R: Ce jour-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q le roi et ses chefs perdront courage. \q Les prêtres seront choqués, \q et les prophètes resteront stupéfaits.

sw.L: Na itakuwa katika siku ile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q moyo wa mfalme utazimia, na moyo wa wakuu; \q na makuhani watashangaa, \q na manabii watastaajabu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mfalme na maafisa watakata tamaa; \q makuhani watatishika, \q na manabii watapigwa na bumbuazi.
sw.R: Wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mfalme na viongozi wake watakosa ujasiri. \q Makuhani watashtuka, \q na manabii watapigwa na bumbuazi.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q lòng của vua sẽ tiêu tan, và lòng của các quan trưởng; \q các thầy tế lễ sẽ kinh hãi, \q và các nhà tiên tri sẽ sững sờ.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, \q vua và các quan chức sẽ mất hết can đảm; \q các thầy tế lễ sẽ kinh hoàng, \q và các nhà tiên tri sẽ sững sờ.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, \q vua và các nhà lãnh đạo sẽ mất hết can đảm. \q Các thầy tế lễ sẽ hoảng sợ, \q và các nhà tiên tri sẽ sững sờ.

ko.L: 그날에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. \q 왕의 마음과 고관들의 마음이 무너지고, \q 제사장들은 놀라며, \q 예언자들은 기겁할 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 왕과 관리들은 낙심하고, \q 제사장들은 질겁하며, \q 예언자들은 넋을 잃을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. \q 왕과 그의 지도자들은 용기를 잃을 것이다. \q 제사장들은 깜짝 놀라고, \q 예언자들은 넋을 잃을 것이다.

pt.L: E acontecerá naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q [que] o coração do rei desfalecerá, e o coração dos príncipes; \q e os sacerdotes ficarão espantados, \q e os profetas ficarão pasmados.
pt.B: Naquele dia, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q o rei e os oficiais vão perder a coragem; \q os sacerdotes ficarão horrorizados, \q e os profetas, atônitos.
pt.R: Naquele dia, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, \q o rei e os seus líderes vão perder a coragem. \q Os sacerdotes vão ficar chocados, \q e os profetas vão ficar pasmos.

am.L: በዚያም ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q የንጉሡ ልብና የመኳንንቱ ልብ ይጠፋል፤ \q ካህናቱም ይደነግጣሉ፤ \q ነቢያቱም ይደነቃሉ።
am.B: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ንጉሡና ሹማምንቱ ልባቸው ይዝላል፤ \q ካህናቱ ይሸበራሉ፤ \q ነቢያቱም ይደነግጣሉ።
am.R: በዚያ ቀን፣ ይላል {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}}፣ \q ንጉሡና መሪዎቹ ድፍረታቸውን ያጣሉ። \q ካህናቱ ይደነግጣሉ፤ \q ነቢያቱም ግራ ይጋባሉ።

hi.L: और उस दिन ऐसा होगा, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q [कि] राजा का हृदय और हाकिमों का हृदय टूट जाएगा; \q और याजक चकित होंगे, \q और भविष्यद्वक्ता अचंभित होंगे।
hi.B: उस दिन, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} की यह वाणी है, \q राजा और अधिकारी हिम्मत हार जाएँगे; \q याजक भयभीत होंगे, \q और भविष्यद्वक्ता स्तब्ध रह जाएँगे।
hi.R: उस समय, {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} कहते हैं, \q राजा और उसके अगुवे साहस खो बैठेंगे। \q याजक हैरान रह जाएँगे, \q और नबी सन्न रह जाएँगे।
