decisions.reason: Tents and their curtains were an old way of speaking of one's home, even for people living in houses (10:20; 2 Samuel 20:1). The speaker's own household is struck as the land falls (m2 at verse 19).

decisions.choice: News comes of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable take "is proclaimed" as the arrival of reports (m1).

decisions.choice: the curtains of my home
decisions.reason: Readable adds "of my home" to show what the tents stand for (m2).

source.text: עַד־מָתַ֖י אֶרְאֶה־נֵּ֑ס אֶשְׁמְעָ֖ה ק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Until when will I see a signal flag, will I hear [the] sound of [the] shofar?

en.L: How long must I see the signal flag, \q [and] hear the sound of the trumpet?
en.B: How long must I look at the signal flag \q and listen to the ram's horn?
en.R: How long must I see the signal flags of war \q and hear the trumpet calling to battle?

es.L: ¿Hasta cuándo veré la bandera, \q [y] oiré el sonido de la trompeta?
es.B: ¿Hasta cuándo tendré que mirar la bandera \q y escuchar el cuerno de carnero?
es.R: ¿Hasta cuándo tendré que ver las banderas de guerra \q y oír la trompeta que llama a la batalla?

fr.L: Jusqu’à quand verrai-je l’étendard, \q [et] entendrai-je le son du cor ?
fr.B: Jusqu’à quand devrai-je regarder l’étendard \q et entendre le son du cor ?
fr.R: Combien de temps devrai-je encore voir les drapeaux de la guerre \q et entendre la trompette qui appelle au combat ?

sw.L: Hata lini nitaiona bendera, \q [na] kuisikia sauti ya baragumu?
sw.B: Nitaitazama bendera hadi lini, \q na kulisikiliza baragumu?
sw.R: Nitaziona bendera za vita hadi lini, \q na kusikia baragumu likiita watu vitani?

vi.L: Tôi phải thấy cờ hiệu \q [và] nghe tiếng kèn cho đến bao giờ?
vi.B: Tôi còn phải nhìn cờ hiệu \q và nghe tiếng tù và cho đến bao giờ?
vi.R: Tôi còn phải thấy cờ hiệu chiến tranh \q và nghe tiếng kèn gọi ra trận cho đến bao giờ?

ko.L: 언제까지 내가 깃발을 보고 \q 나팔 소리를 들어야 하느냐?
ko.B: 언제까지 내가 신호 깃발을 바라보며 \q 숫양 뿔 나팔 소리를 들어야 하느냐?
ko.R: 언제까지 내가 전쟁의 깃발을 보고 \q 싸우러 나오라는 나팔 소리를 들어야 하느냐?

pt.L: Até quando verei a bandeira, \q [e] ouvirei o som do chifre de carneiro?
pt.B: Até quando terei de olhar a bandeira de sinal \q e ouvir o chifre de carneiro?
pt.R: Até quando vou ter de ver as bandeiras de guerra \q e ouvir a trombeta chamando para a batalha?

am.L: ዓርማውን የማየው፣ \q የመለከትንም ድምፅ የምሰማው እስከ መቼ ነው?
am.B: ዓርማውን የምመለከተው \q የቀንድ መለከቱንም የማዳምጠው እስከ መቼ ነው?
am.R: የጦርነት ዓርማዎችን የማየው \q ወደ ጦርነት የሚጠራውንም መለከት የምሰማው እስከ መቼ ነው?

hi.L: मैं कब तक झंडा देखता रहूँ, \q [और] नरसिंगे का शब्द सुनता रहूँ?
hi.B: कब तक मुझे संकेत का झंडा देखना \q और नरसिंगे की आवाज़ सुननी पड़ेगी?
hi.R: कब तक मुझे युद्ध के झंडे देखने पड़ेंगे \q और लड़ाई के लिए बुलाते नरसिंगे की आवाज़ सुननी पड़ेगी?

ru.L: Доколе мне видеть знамя, \q [и] слышать звук трубы?
ru.B: Сколько ещё мне смотреть на знамя \q и слушать звук рога?
ru.R: Сколько ещё мне видеть военные знамёна \q и слышать трубу, зовущую на битву?

ja.L: いつまで、わたしは旗を見、 \q 角笛の音を聞かなければならないのか？
ja.B: いつまで、わたしは合図の旗を見つめ、 \q 角笛の音に耳を傾けなければならないのか？
ja.R: いつまで、わたしは戦いの合図の旗を見て、 \q 戦いを呼びかける角笛を聞かなければならないのか？

decisions.choice: the signal flag and the shofar: the signs of war going on
decisions.reason: The same flag and horn that called the people to flee (verses 5-6) now mark a war that seems never to end. The question "how long" is a lament (12:4; Psalm 13:2).

decisions.choice: of war ... calling to battle
decisions.reason: Readable says what the flag and the trumpet signal (m1).

source.text: כִּ֣י׀אֱוִ֣יל עַמִּ֗י אוֹתִי֙ לֹ֣א יָדָ֔עוּ בָּנִ֤ים סְכָלִים֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְלֹ֥א נְבוֹנִ֖ים הֵ֑מָּה חֲכָמִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ לְהָרַ֔ע וּלְהֵיטִ֖יב לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For foolish [is] my people; me they do not know; children stupid [are] they, and not understanding [are] they; wise [are] they to do evil, but to do good they do not know.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people are foolish; {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} they do not know; \q they are stupid children, \q and they have no understanding. \q They are wise at doing evil, \q but to do good they do not know [how].
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people are fools; they do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They are senseless children; \q they have no understanding. \q They are skilled at doing evil, \q but they do not know how to do good.
en.R: This is happening because {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people are foolish. They do not know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They are like silly children \q who understand nothing. \q They are experts at doing wrong, \q but they do not know how to do what is right.

es.L: Porque necio [es] {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo; a {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen; \q son hijos insensatos, \q y no tienen entendimiento. \q Son sabios para hacer el mal, \q pero hacer el bien no saben.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo es necio; no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen. \q Son hijos sin juicio; \q no tienen entendimiento. \q Son hábiles para hacer el mal, \q pero no saben hacer el bien.
es.R: Esto sucede porque {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo es necio. No {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocen. \q Son como niños tontos \q que no entienden nada. \q Son expertos en hacer lo malo, \q pero no saben hacer lo que es bueno.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple est insensé ; ils ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent pas ; \q ce sont des enfants stupides, \q et ils n’ont pas d’intelligence. \q Ils sont sages pour faire le mal, \q mais faire le bien, ils ne [le] savent pas.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple est fou ; ils ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent pas. \q Ce sont des enfants insensés ; \q ils n’ont aucune intelligence. \q Ils sont habiles à faire le mal, \q mais ils ne savent pas faire le bien.
fr.R: Tout cela arrive parce que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple est fou. Ils ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaissent pas. \q Ils sont comme des enfants sans cervelle \q qui ne comprennent rien. \q Ils sont très forts pour faire le mal, \q mais ils ne savent pas faire ce qui est bien.

sw.L: Kwa maana watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ni wapumbavu; {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} hawanijui; \q ni watoto wajinga, \q wala hawana ufahamu. \q Wana hekima ya kutenda mabaya, \q lakini kutenda mema hawajui.
sw.B: Kwa maana watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ni wapumbavu; hawanijui. \q Ni watoto wasio na akili; \q hawana ufahamu. \q Ni stadi wa kutenda mabaya, \q lakini hawajui kutenda mema.
sw.R: Haya yanatokea kwa sababu watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} ni wapumbavu. Hawanijui. \q Ni kama watoto wajinga \q wasioelewa chochote. \q Ni wataalamu wa kutenda mabaya, \q lakini hawajui jinsi ya kutenda yaliyo mema.

vi.L: Vì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngu dại; chúng không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q chúng là con cái khờ dại, \q và chúng không có sự hiểu biết. \q Chúng khôn ngoan để làm điều ác, \q nhưng làm điều lành thì chúng không biết.
vi.B: Vì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là kẻ ngu dại; chúng không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng là những đứa con dại khờ; \q chúng chẳng có chút hiểu biết. \q Chúng giỏi làm điều ác, \q nhưng không biết làm điều lành.
vi.R: Điều này xảy ra vì dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ngu dại. Chúng không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng như những đứa trẻ khờ dại \q chẳng hiểu biết gì. \q Chúng rất thạo làm điều sai trái, \q nhưng không biết làm điều phải.

ko.L: 내 백성은 어리석다. 그들은 나를 알지 못한다. \q 그들은 미련한 자식들이고, \q 깨달음이 없다. \q 그들은 악을 행하는 데는 지혜로우나 \q 선을 행할 줄은 모른다.
ko.B: 내 백성은 어리석어서 나를 알지 못한다. \q 그들은 분별없는 자식들이어서 \q 깨닫는 것이 없다. \q 악한 일을 하는 데는 능숙하지만 \q 선한 일을 할 줄은 모른다.
ko.R: 이 일이 일어나는 것은 내 백성이 어리석기 때문이다. 그들은 나를 알지 못한다. \q 그들은 철없는 아이들 같아서 \q 아무것도 깨닫지 못한다. \q 그들은 나쁜 짓을 하는 데는 전문가이지만 \q 옳은 일을 할 줄은 모른다.

pt.L: Pois o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo é tolo; a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} não conhecem; \q são filhos insensatos, \q e não têm entendimento. \q São sábios para fazer o mal, \q mas fazer o bem não sabem.
pt.B: Pois o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo é insensato; eles não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecem. \q São crianças sem juízo; \q não têm entendimento. \q São hábeis para fazer o mal, \q mas não sabem fazer o bem.
pt.R: Isso está acontecendo porque o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo é tolo. Eles não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecem. \q São como crianças bobas \q que não entendem nada. \q São especialistas em fazer o que é errado, \q mas não sabem fazer o que é certo.

am.L: ሕዝቤ ሰነፎች ናቸውና፤ እኔን አያውቁኝም፤ \q ሞኞች ልጆች ናቸው፤ \q ማስተዋልም የላቸውም። \q ክፉ ለማድረግ ጥበበኞች ናቸው፤ \q መልካም ማድረግን ግን አያውቁም።
am.B: ሕዝቤ ሰነፎች ናቸውና፤ አያውቁኝም። \q ሞኞች ልጆች ናቸው፤ \q ማስተዋል የላቸውም። \q ክፉ በማድረግ የተካኑ ናቸው፤ \q መልካም ማድረግን ግን አያውቁም።
am.R: ይህ የሆነው ሕዝቤ ሰነፎች ስለ ሆኑ ነው። አያውቁኝም። \q እንደ ሞኞች ልጆች ናቸው፤ \q ምንም አያስተውሉም። \q ክፉ በማድረግ የተካኑ ናቸው፤ \q ትክክል የሆነውን ማድረግ ግን አያውቁም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मेरी प्रजा मूर्ख है; वे मुझे नहीं जानते; \q वे बुद्धिहीन बच्चे हैं, \q और उनमें कुछ समझ नहीं। \q बुराई करने में वे बुद्धिमान हैं, \q पर भलाई करना वे नहीं जानते।
hi.B: क्योंकि मेरी प्रजा मूर्ख है; वे मुझे नहीं जानते। \q वे नासमझ बच्चे हैं; \q उनमें कोई समझ नहीं। \q बुराई करने में वे चतुर हैं, \q पर भलाई करना वे नहीं जानते।
hi.R: यह इसलिए हो रहा है क्योंकि मेरे लोग मूर्ख हैं। वे मुझे नहीं जानते। \q वे नासमझ बच्चों के समान हैं \q जो कुछ नहीं समझते। \q ग़लत काम करने में वे माहिर हैं, \q पर सही काम करना वे नहीं जानते।

ru.L: Ведь глуп {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ; {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}} они не знают; \q дети неразумные они, \q и нет у них понимания. \q Мудры они на зло, \q а делать добро не умеют.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ глуп; они не знают {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Они неразумные дети; \q у них нет понимания. \q Они искусны в том, чтобы делать зло, \q а делать добро не умеют.
ru.R: Это происходит потому, что {{deity_pronoun:мой|Мой}} народ глуп. Они не знают {{deity_pronoun:меня|Меня}}. \q Они как глупые дети, \q которые ничего не понимают. \q Они мастера делать зло, \q но не умеют делать добро.

ja.L: まことに、わたしの民は愚かで、わたしを知らない。 \q 彼らは愚かな子らで、 \q 悟りがない。 \q 悪を行うことには賢いが、 \q 善を行うことを知らない。
ja.B: わたしの民は愚か者で、わたしを知らない。 \q 彼らは分別のない子らで、 \q 悟ることがない。 \q 悪を行うことには長けているが、 \q 善を行うすべを知らない。
ja.R: こうなったのは、わたしの民が愚かだからだ。彼らはわたしを知らない。 \q 彼らは、ばかな子どもたちのようで、 \q 何も分かっていない。 \q 悪いことをするのは得意だが、 \q 正しいことをするやり方を知らない。

decisions.choice: my people ... me: the LORD answers the prophet's lament
decisions.reason: The speaker changes from the prophet (verses 19-21) to the LORD, who gives the reason for the disaster. The word "for" ties his answer to the cry "how long".

decisions.choice: know: acknowledge, be in a close relationship with
decisions.reason: To know the LORD is more than knowing facts about him: it is to trust and obey him and live in his covenant (2:8; 9:23; 22:16; Hosea 4:1).

decisions.choice: foolish, stupid, without understanding: moral folly, not lack of intelligence
decisions.reason: The words describe people who have the wit to plan evil well but refuse to live wisely before God (Proverbs 1:7). They are clever in the wrong things.

decisions.choice: This is happening because
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what "for" points back to: the disaster of verses 19-21 (m1).

decisions.choice: "ሰነፎች" for the people (ʾewil); "ሞኞች ልጆች" for the children (sakhal)
decisions.reason: The wisdom words keep the forms of the Nehemiah-Proverbs list: "ሰነፍ" for ʾewil; "ሞኝ" for the senseless.

decisions.choice: God answers the prophet in his own plain voice; yada' "知る" at every level (m2), as Hosea; sekhalim "愚かな" (L), "分別のない" (B).
decisions.reason: Moral folly, not lack of wit (m3).

source.text: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִנֵּה־תֹ֖הוּ וָבֹ֑הוּ וְאֶל־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ין אוֹרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I looked at the earth, and look, formlessness and emptiness; and to the heavens, and there was not their light.

en.L: I looked at the earth, and look, [it was] formlessness and emptiness; \q and to the heavens, and their light [was] not [there].
en.B: I looked at the earth, and it was without form and empty; \q I looked to the heavens, and their light was gone.
en.R: I looked at the earth. It did not have any shape, and it was empty. \q I looked up at the sky, and there was no light.

es.L: Miré la tierra, y he aquí [que era] caos y vacío; \q y a los cielos, y no [había] su luz.
es.B: Miré la tierra, y estaba sin forma y vacía; \q miré los cielos, y su luz había desaparecido.
es.R: Miré la tierra. No tenía forma, y estaba vacía. \q Miré hacia el cielo, y no había luz.

fr.L: J’ai regardé la terre, et voici, [elle était] désolation et vide ; \q et les cieux, et leur lumière n’[était] plus.
fr.B: J’ai regardé la terre : elle était sans forme et vide ; \q j’ai regardé vers les cieux : leur lumière avait disparu.
fr.R: J’ai regardé la terre. Elle n’avait plus aucune forme, et elle était vide. \q J’ai levé les yeux vers le ciel, et il n’y avait plus de lumière.

sw.L: Niliitazama nchi, na tazama, [ilikuwa] ukiwa na utupu; \q na mbingu, na nuru yao haikuwako.
sw.B: Niliitazama dunia, nayo ilikuwa bila umbo, tena tupu; \q nilitazama mbingu, na nuru yake ilikuwa imetoweka.
sw.R: Niliitazama dunia. Haikuwa na umbo lolote, nayo ilikuwa tupu. \q Nilitazama juu angani, na hapakuwa na nuru.

vi.L: Tôi nhìn trái đất, và kìa, [nó] trống không và hỗn độn; \q [nhìn] lên các tầng trời, và ánh sáng của chúng không [còn].
vi.B: Tôi nhìn trái đất, thấy nó không có hình dạng và trống rỗng; \q tôi nhìn lên các tầng trời, thấy ánh sáng đã biến mất.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn trái đất. Nó không có hình dạng gì, và trống trơn. \q Tôi nhìn lên bầu trời, và không có ánh sáng nào cả.

ko.L: 내가 땅을 보았더니, 보아라, 혼돈과 공허였다. \q 하늘들을 [보았더니] 그 빛이 없었다.
ko.B: 내가 땅을 보았더니 형체도 없이 텅 비어 있었다. \q 하늘을 쳐다보았더니 빛이 사라지고 없었다.
ko.R: 내가 땅을 보았다. 땅은 아무 모양도 없이 텅 비어 있었다. \q 하늘을 올려다보았다. 빛이 하나도 없었다.

pt.L: Olhei para a terra, e eis que [era] sem forma e vazia; \q e para os céus, e a sua luz não [estava lá].
pt.B: Olhei para a terra, e ela não tinha forma e estava vazia; \q olhei para os céus, e a sua luz tinha sumido.
pt.R: Olhei para a terra. Ela não tinha nenhuma forma e estava vazia. \q Olhei para o céu, e não havia luz.

am.L: ምድርን አየሁ፤ እነሆም፣ ቅርጽ የለሽና ባዶ [ነበረች]፤ \q ሰማያትንም [አየሁ]፤ ብርሃናቸውም አልነበረም።
am.B: ምድርን አየሁ፤ ቅርጽ የሌላትና ባዶ ነበረች፤ \q ወደ ሰማይም ተመለከትኩ፤ ብርሃኑም ጠፍቶ ነበር።
am.R: ምድርን አየሁ። ቅርጽ አልነበራትም፤ ባዶም ነበረች። \q ቀና ብዬ ሰማዩን አየሁ፤ ብርሃንም አልነበረም።

hi.L: मैंने पृथ्वी को देखा, और देखो, [वह] आकारहीन और ख़ाली [थी]; \q और आकाश को, और उसका प्रकाश न [था]।
hi.B: मैंने पृथ्वी को देखा, और वह बिना आकार की और ख़ाली थी; \q मैंने आकाश की ओर देखा, और उसकी ज्योति जाती रही थी।
hi.R: मैंने पृथ्वी को देखा। उसका कोई आकार नहीं था, और वह ख़ाली थी। \q मैंने ऊपर आकाश की ओर देखा, और वहाँ कोई रोशनी नहीं थी।

ru.L: Я посмотрел на землю, и вот, [она] — бесформенность и пустота; \q и на небеса — и нет их света.
ru.B: Я посмотрел на землю, и она была без формы и пуста; \q я посмотрел на небеса, и их свет исчез.
ru.R: Я посмотрел на землю. У неё не было никакого вида, и она была пустой. \q Я посмотрел на небо, и там не было света.

ja.L: わたしは地を見た。なんと、[それは]混沌と空虚であった。 \q また天を[見た]。その光はなかった。
ja.B: わたしは地を見た。それは形がなく、何もなかった。 \q 天を見上げると、その光は消えていた。
ja.R: わたしは地を見た。それには形がなく、空っぽだった。 \q 空を見上げると、光がなかった。

decisions.choice: formless and empty, with no light: the world as it was before God's first word in Genesis 1:2-3
decisions.reason: The rhyming pair of words appears together only here and in Genesis 1:2 (Isaiah 34:11 sets them in parallel lines). In Genesis the earth was formless and empty and dark until God said, "Let there be light". In Jeremiah's vision the judgment runs creation backward: the land returns to that state, and the light is gone.

decisions.choice: I looked ... and look: a vision, told in four matching lines
decisions.reason: Verses 23-26 each begin "I looked, and look". The prophet describes what he saw in a vision of the coming judgment; the repeated words give it the shape of a poem in four stanzas.

decisions.choice: the earth: the whole earth in the vision
decisions.reason: The word can mean the land or the whole earth. Set beside "the heavens" and the words of Genesis 1:2, it is the earth in this vision, although the judgment it pictures falls on Judah (verses 26-27).

decisions.choice: formlessness and emptiness (L); without form and empty (B); did not have any shape ... empty (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses its own wording from Genesis 1:2, so that a reader of either passage hears the other (m1).

decisions.choice: (look left out) ... I looked to the heavens / I looked up at the sky
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out the second "look", which Literal keeps, and repeat "I looked" where the Hebrew lets it be understood.

decisions.choice: "caos y vacío" (L); "sin forma y vacía" (B); "No tenía forma, y estaba vacía" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of Genesis 1:2 (tohu wabohu); each level keeps the wording a reader can hear as an echo of creation undone, following the English levels. Balanced and Readable leave out "he aquí", as the English does.

decisions.choice: ukiwa na utupu (Literal); bila umbo, tena tupu (Balanced); haikuwa na umbo ... tupu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words of the world before creation (Genesis 1:2, meaning decision m1) worded so the echo can be heard at each level.

decisions.choice: "désolation et vide" (L); "sans forme et vide" (B); "n’avait plus aucune forme ... vide" (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses its own wording of Genesis 1:2 in the French Pentateuch, so that the reader hears the echo (m1).

decisions.choice: passé composé "j’ai regardé" at every level
decisions.reason: The vision of verses 23-26 is part of the prophet's spoken poem, not narrative prose, so it takes the tense of speech at every level.

decisions.choice: 혼돈과 공허 (Literal); 형체도 없이 텅 비어 (Balanced); 아무 모양도 없이 텅 비어 (Readable)
decisions.reason: The words are those of Genesis 1:2. Literal uses the nouns of the published Genesis wording so the echo can be heard; Balanced and Readable say it plainly.

decisions.choice: sem forma e vazia (L); não tinha forma e estava vazia (B); não tinha nenhuma forma e estava vazia (R)
decisions.reason: The pair is the one of Genesis 1:2 (m1), and the English uses each level's own wording of that verse (r-en-1). Portuguese does the same with Genesis 1:2's Portuguese at each level, so that the reader hears the creation undone; Literal follows Genesis rather than turning the adjectives into nouns.

decisions.choice: "ቅርጽ የለሽና ባዶ" (Literal); "ቅርጽ የሌላትና ባዶ" (Balanced)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pair (tohu wa-vohu) is that of Genesis 1:2, so the Amharic uses the words of Genesis 1:2 on main at each level, and the earth undone is heard as creation reversed.

decisions.choice: आकारहीन और ख़ाली (L); बिना आकार की और ख़ाली (B); उसका कोई आकार नहीं था, और वह ख़ाली थी (R)
decisions.reason: tohu wabohu is worded at each level as Genesis 1:2 has it in this translation, so that a reader of either passage hears the other (m1).

decisions.choice: бесформенность и пустота (L); без формы и пуста (B); не было никакого вида ... пустой (R)
decisions.reason: Each level uses its own wording of Genesis 1:2 in this translation, so the reader hears the creation undone, and not the Synodal "безвидна и пуста".

decisions.choice: tohu vavohu "混沌と空虚" (L), "形がなく、何もなかった" (B), "形がなく、空っぽだった" (R), echoing Genesis 1:2; hinneh in a report "なんと" (L), dropped (B, R), as the prophetic convention; the four "I looked" lines (4:23-26) keep one pattern.
decisions.reason: The vision is the prophet's verse, plain at every level.

source.text: רָאִ֨יתִי֙ הֶֽהָרִ֔ים וְהִנֵּ֖ה רֹעֲשִׁ֑ים וְכָל־הַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְקַלְקָֽלוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I looked at the mountains, and look, quaking; and all the hills shook to and fro.

en.L: I looked at the mountains, and look, [they were] quaking, \q and all the hills were swaying.
en.B: I looked at the mountains, and they were quaking; \q all the hills were rocking back and forth.
en.R: I looked at the mountains, and they were shaking. \q All the hills were swaying back and forth.

es.L: Miré los montes, y he aquí [que] temblaban, \q y todas las colinas se tambaleaban.
es.B: Miré los montes, y estaban temblando; \q todas las colinas se mecían de un lado a otro.
es.R: Miré los montes, y estaban temblando. \q Todas las colinas se movían de un lado a otro.

fr.L: J’ai regardé les montagnes, et voici, [elles] tremblaient, \q et toutes les collines vacillaient.
fr.B: J’ai regardé les montagnes : elles tremblaient ; \q toutes les collines oscillaient.
fr.R: J’ai regardé les montagnes, et elles tremblaient. \q Toutes les collines se balançaient d’un côté à l’autre.

sw.L: Niliitazama milima, na tazama, [ilikuwa] ikitetemeka, \q na vilima vyote vilikuwa vikiyumbayumba.
sw.B: Niliitazama milima, nayo ilikuwa ikitetemeka; \q vilima vyote vilikuwa vikiyumba huku na huko.
sw.R: Niliitazama milima, nayo ilikuwa ikitikisika. \q Vilima vyote vilikuwa vikiyumba huku na huko.

vi.L: Tôi nhìn các núi, và kìa, [chúng] đang rung chuyển, \q và mọi đồi đều lắc lư.
vi.B: Tôi nhìn các núi, thấy chúng đang rung chuyển; \q mọi đồi đều lắc qua lắc lại.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn các núi, và chúng đang rung chuyển. \q Mọi đồi đều lắc lư qua lại.

ko.L: 내가 산들을 보았더니, 보아라, 그것들이 진동하고 있었고, \q 모든 언덕이 흔들리고 있었다.
ko.B: 내가 산들을 보았더니 그것들이 떨고 있었고, \q 모든 언덕이 이리저리 흔들리고 있었다.
ko.R: 내가 산들을 보았다. 산들이 흔들리고 있었다. \q 모든 언덕이 이리저리 흔들거리고 있었다.

pt.L: Olhei para os montes, e eis que tremiam, \q e todas as colinas oscilavam.
pt.B: Olhei para os montes, e eles estavam tremendo; \q todas as colinas balançavam de um lado para o outro.
pt.R: Olhei para os montes, e eles estavam tremendo. \q Todas as colinas balançavam para lá e para cá.

am.L: ተራሮችን አየሁ፤ እነሆም፣ ይናወጡ ነበር፤ \q ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ይወዛወዙ ነበር።
am.B: ተራሮችን አየሁ፤ ይንቀጠቀጡ ነበር፤ \q ኮረብቶችም ሁሉ ወዲያና ወዲህ ይወዛወዙ ነበር።
am.R: ተራሮችን አየሁ፤ ይንቀጠቀጡ ነበር። \q ኮረብቶች ሁሉ ወዲያና ወዲህ ይወዛወዙ ነበር።

hi.L: मैंने पहाड़ों को देखा, और देखो, [वे] काँप रहे थे, \q और सब पहाड़ियाँ डोल रही थीं।
hi.B: मैंने पहाड़ों को देखा, और वे काँप रहे थे; \q सब पहाड़ियाँ इधर-उधर डगमगा रही थीं।
hi.R: मैंने पहाड़ों को देखा, और वे हिल रहे थे। \q सब पहाड़ियाँ इधर-उधर डोल रही थीं।

ru.L: Я посмотрел на горы, и вот, [они] дрожат, \q и все холмы колеблются.
ru.B: Я посмотрел на горы, и они дрожали; \q все холмы раскачивались туда и сюда.
ru.R: Я посмотрел на горы, и они тряслись. \q Все холмы качались туда и сюда.

ja.L: わたしは山々を見た。なんと、[それらは]揺れ動き、 \q すべての丘は揺らいでいた。
ja.B: わたしは山々を見た。山々は震え、 \q すべての丘は前後に揺れていた。
ja.R: わたしは山々を見た。山々は揺れていた。 \q すべての丘が、前に後ろに揺れていた。

decisions.choice: the mountains quaking: even what is most firm gives way
decisions.reason: Mountains stand for what is solid and lasting (Psalm 46:3-4; Isaiah 54:10). When the LORD comes in judgment they shake (Nahum 1:5; Judges 5:5).

decisions.choice: shook to and fro: swayed lightly back and forth
decisions.reason: The verb comes from a root meaning "light". The hills rock as if they had no weight.

decisions.choice: (look left out)
decisions.reason: As in verse 23, Balanced and Readable leave out "look", which Literal keeps.

source.text: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֖ה אֵ֣ין הָאָדָ֑ם וְכָל־ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נָדָֽדוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I looked, and look, there was not the human, and all [the] birds of the heavens had fled.

en.L: I looked, and look, there was no human being, \q and all the birds of the heavens had fled.
en.B: I looked, and there was no one at all; \q every bird in the sky had flown away.
en.R: I looked, and there were no people. \q All the birds had flown away.

es.L: Miré, y he aquí [que] no había ser humano, \q y todas las aves de los cielos habían huido.
es.B: Miré, y no había nadie; \q todas las aves del cielo se habían ido volando.
es.R: Miré, y no había gente. \q Todas las aves se habían ido volando.

fr.L: J’ai regardé, et voici, il n’y avait pas d’être humain, \q et tous les oiseaux des cieux s’étaient enfuis.
fr.B: J’ai regardé : il n’y avait plus personne ; \q tous les oiseaux du ciel s’étaient envolés.
fr.R: J’ai regardé, et il n’y avait plus personne. \q Tous les oiseaux s’étaient envolés.

sw.L: Nilitazama, na tazama, hapakuwa na mwanadamu, \q na ndege wote wa angani walikuwa wamekimbia.
sw.B: Nilitazama, wala hapakuwa na mtu hata mmoja; \q kila ndege wa angani alikuwa ameruka akaenda zake.
sw.R: Nilitazama, wala hapakuwa na watu. \q Ndege wote walikuwa wameruka wakaenda zao.

vi.L: Tôi nhìn, và kìa, không có con người, \q và mọi chim trời đều đã bay trốn.
vi.B: Tôi nhìn, chẳng thấy một ai; \q mọi chim trời đều đã bay đi mất.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn, và chẳng có người nào. \q Mọi loài chim đều đã bay đi hết.

ko.L: 내가 보았더니, 보아라, 사람이 없었고, \q 하늘의 새들이 모두 날아가 버렸다.
ko.B: 내가 보았더니 사람이라고는 하나도 없었고, \q 하늘의 새들도 모두 날아가 버렸다.
ko.R: 내가 보았다. 사람이 하나도 없었다. \q 새들도 모두 날아가 버렸다.

pt.L: Olhei, e eis que não havia ser humano, \q e todas as aves dos céus tinham fugido.
pt.B: Olhei, e não havia ninguém; \q todas as aves do céu tinham voado para longe.
pt.R: Olhei, e não havia gente. \q Todas as aves tinham ido embora voando.

am.L: አየሁ፤ እነሆም፣ ሰው አልነበረም፤ \q የሰማይም ወፎች ሁሉ ሸሽተው ነበር።
am.B: አየሁ፤ ማንም ሰው አልነበረም፤ \q በሰማይ ያሉ ወፎች ሁሉ በረው ሄደው ነበር።
am.R: አየሁ፤ ሰዎች አልነበሩም። \q ወፎች ሁሉ በረው ሄደው ነበር።

hi.L: मैंने देखा, और देखो, कोई मनुष्य न था, \q और आकाश के सब पक्षी उड़ गए थे।
hi.B: मैंने देखा, और कोई भी न था; \q आकाश का हर पक्षी उड़ चुका था।
hi.R: मैंने देखा, और वहाँ कोई लोग नहीं थे। \q सब पक्षी उड़ गए थे।

ru.L: Я посмотрел, и вот, нет человека, \q и все птицы небесные улетели.
ru.B: Я посмотрел, и не было никого; \q все птицы небесные улетели.
ru.R: Я посмотрел, и людей не было. \q Все птицы улетели.

ja.L: わたしは見た。なんと、人はいなかった。 \q 空の鳥もみな逃げ去っていた。
ja.B: わたしは見た。人は一人もいなかった。 \q 空の鳥もみな飛び去っていた。
ja.R: わたしは見た。人がだれもいなかった。 \q 鳥もみな飛んで行ってしまった。

decisions.choice: no human, no birds: the creatures of the fifth and sixth days gone
decisions.reason: In Genesis 1 the birds were made on the fifth day and humankind on the sixth (Genesis 1:20, 26-27). The vision takes them away again (compare 9:9; Zephaniah 1:3; Hosea 4:3).

decisions.choice: the human: humankind, people
decisions.reason: The word with the article means humankind as a whole, men and women alike, not one man.

decisions.choice: (look left out)
decisions.reason: As in verse 23.

decisions.choice: ha'adam "人" (every level), no gender span (the English has none).
decisions.reason: Japanese 人 already means humankind.

source.text: רָאִ֕יתִי וְהִנֵּ֥ה הַכַּרְמֶ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְכָל־עָרָ֗יו נִתְּצוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: I looked, and look, the orchard land [was] the wilderness, and all its cities were pulled down before Yahweh, before [the] burning of his anger.

en.L: I looked, and look, the orchard land [was] the wilderness, \q and all its cities were pulled down before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} burning anger.
en.B: I looked, and the orchard land had become a desert; \q all its towns had been torn down before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger.
en.R: I looked, and the land of rich orchards had become a desert. \q All its towns had been torn down. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} had done this in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} fierce anger.

es.L: Miré, y he aquí [que] la tierra de huertos [era] el desierto, \q y todas sus ciudades estaban derribadas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q delante del ardor de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ira.
es.B: Miré, y la tierra de huertos se había vuelto un desierto; \q todas sus ciudades habían sido derribadas ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ardiente ira.
es.R: Miré, y la tierra de ricos huertos se había convertido en un desierto. \q Todas sus ciudades habían sido derribadas. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había hecho en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} ardiente ira.

fr.L: J’ai regardé, et voici, le pays des vergers [était] le désert, \q et toutes ses villes étaient abattues devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q devant l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère.
fr.B: J’ai regardé : le pays des vergers était devenu un désert ; \q toutes ses villes avaient été abattues devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ardente.
fr.R: J’ai regardé, et le pays aux riches vergers était devenu un désert. \q Toutes ses villes avaient été démolies. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait cela dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} colère ardente.

sw.L: Nilitazama, na tazama, nchi ya bustani [ilikuwa] jangwa, \q na miji yake yote ilikuwa imebomolewa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mbele ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali.
sw.B: Nilitazama, na nchi ya bustani ilikuwa imekuwa jangwa; \q miji yake yote ilikuwa imebomolewa mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mbele ya hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali.
sw.R: Nilitazama, na nchi ya bustani nyingi za matunda ilikuwa imekuwa jangwa. \q Miji yake yote ilikuwa imebomolewa. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amefanya hivyo katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kali.

vi.L: Tôi nhìn, và kìa, đất vườn tược [đã thành] hoang mạc, \q và mọi thành của nó đều bị phá sập trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q trước cơn giận nóng cháy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi nhìn, thấy đất vườn tược đã trở thành sa mạc; \q mọi thành của nó đều bị phá đổ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q trước cơn giận dữ dội của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi nhìn, và vùng đất đầy vườn cây trái đã trở thành sa mạc. \q Mọi thành của nó đều bị phá đổ. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm điều đó trong cơn giận dữ dội của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 내가 보았더니, 보아라, 과수원의 땅이 광야가 되었고, \q 그 모든 성읍이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서, \q 그분의 타오르는 분노 앞에서 무너졌다.
ko.B: 내가 보았더니 과수원의 땅이 사막이 되었고, \q 그 모든 성읍이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서, \q 그분의 맹렬한 분노 앞에서 무너져 있었다.
ko.R: 내가 보았다. 기름진 과수원의 땅이 사막이 되어 있었다. \q 그 땅의 성읍들이 모두 무너져 있었다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 몹시 노하셔서 그렇게 하신 것이다.

pt.L: Olhei, e eis que a terra de pomar [era] o deserto, \q e todas as suas cidades estavam derrubadas diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q diante do ardor da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira.
pt.B: Olhei, e a terra de pomares tinha virado um deserto; \q todas as suas cidades tinham sido derrubadas diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira ardente.
pt.R: Olhei, e a terra cheia de pomares tinha virado um deserto. \q Todas as suas cidades tinham sido derrubadas. \q {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito isso na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} ira ardente.

am.L: አየሁ፤ እነሆም፣ የፍራፍሬ እርሻው ምድር ምድረ በዳ [ሆኖ ነበር]፤ \q ከተሞቹም ሁሉ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፣ \q በሚነድደው ቁጣው ፊት ፈርሰው ነበር።
am.B: አየሁ፤ የፍራፍሬ እርሻው ምድር በረሃ ሆኖ ነበር፤ \q ከተሞቹም ሁሉ {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ፊት፣ \q በጽኑ ቁጣው ፊት ፈራርሰው ነበር።
am.R: አየሁ፤ የለመለመው የፍራፍሬ ምድር በረሃ ሆኖ ነበር። \q ከተሞቹ ሁሉ ፈራርሰው ነበር። \q {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይህን ያደረገው በጽኑ ቁጣው ነበር።

hi.L: मैंने देखा, और देखो, फलदार बारी का देश निर्जन प्रदेश [था], \q और उसके सब नगर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, \q उनके भड़के हुए क्रोध के सामने ढा दिए गए थे।
hi.B: मैंने देखा, और फलदार बाग़ों का देश मरुभूमि बन गया था; \q उसके सब नगर {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के सामने, \q उनके भड़के हुए क्रोध के सामने ढा दिए गए थे।
hi.R: मैंने देखा, और हरे-भरे बाग़ों का देश रेगिस्तान बन गया था। \q उसके सब नगर ढा दिए गए थे। \q {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने अपने भड़के हुए क्रोध में यह किया था।

ru.L: Я посмотрел, и вот, земля садов — пустыня, \q и все её города разрушены перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, \q перед {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пылающим гневом.
ru.B: Я посмотрел, и земля садов стала пустыней; \q все её города были разрушены перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}}, \q перед {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} пылающим гневом.
ru.R: Я посмотрел, и земля богатых садов стала пустыней. \q Все её города были разрушены. \q {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} сделал это в своём пылающем гневе.

ja.L: わたしは見た。なんと、果樹園の地は荒れ野[となり]、 \q その町々はみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前に、 \q その燃える怒りの前に、打ち倒されていた。
ja.B: わたしは見た。果樹園の地は荒れ野となり、 \q その町々はみな、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}の前で、 \q その激しい怒りの前で、取り壊されていた。
ja.R: わたしは見た。豊かな果樹園の地は、荒れ野になっていた。 \q 町々はみな、取り壊されていた。 \q {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}が激しく怒って、そうなさったのだ。

decisions.choice: the orchard land: the fertile, cultivated land
decisions.reason: The word means garden land, land planted with vines and fruit trees. In 2:7 the LORD brought Israel "into a land of orchards". It is not Mount Carmel here, since it is set against the desert as fruitful land against barren.

decisions.choice: the wilderness: the fruitful land has become the desert itself
decisions.reason: The two nouns stand side by side with no verb: the garden land "was the wilderness". It is the reverse of the promise that the desert would become a garden (Isaiah 32:15; 35:1-2).

decisions.choice: before the LORD, before his burning anger: at his presence, by his anger
decisions.reason: "Before" (literally "from the face of") means "because of, at the coming of". The ruin is the LORD's work, the fierce anger named in verse 8.

decisions.choice: the orchard land (L, B); the land of rich orchards (R)
decisions.reason: The word is "orchard" at every level, as in Isaiah. Here it names the whole fertile land (m1), so all three levels say "land".

decisions.choice: The LORD had done this
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "before the LORD" means (m3).

decisions.choice: "le pays des vergers" (L, B); "le pays aux riches vergers" (R), for *karmel* as the fertile land
decisions.reason: As in 2:7, the word names fertile orchard land, not Mount Carmel.

decisions.choice: hakkarmel "果樹園の地" (L, B), "豊かな果樹園の地" (R), as 2:7; nittetsu "打ち倒された" (L), "取り壊された" (B, R); the prophet speaks of the LORD with a light respect form at Readable ("そうなさった").
decisions.reason: The prophet's vision, so the LORD as subject takes a respect form.

source.text: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שְׁמָמָ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְכָלָ֖ה לֹ֥א אֶעֱשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh: A desolation will be all the land, but a full end not I will make.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: \q A desolation the whole land will be, \q yet a full end I will not make.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this: \q The whole land will be laid waste, \q but I will not destroy it completely.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: \q The whole land will be ruined, \q but I will not destroy it completely.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Desolación será toda la tierra, \q pero no haré un exterminio total.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: \q Toda la tierra quedará desolada, \q pero no la destruiré por completo.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: \q Toda la tierra quedará arruinada, \q pero no la destruiré por completo.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Une désolation sera tout le pays, \q mais je ne ferai pas une destruction totale.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : \q Tout le pays sera dévasté, \q mais je ne le détruirai pas entièrement.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q Tout le pays sera ruiné, \q mais je ne le détruirai pas complètement.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: \q Ukiwa itakuwa nchi yote, \q lakini ukomo kamili sitafanya.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: \q Nchi yote itaharibiwa, \q lakini sitaiangamiza kabisa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: \q Nchi yote itaharibiwa, \q lakini sitaiangamiza kabisa.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: \q Cả xứ sẽ thành hoang vu, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không tận diệt.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: \q Cả xứ sẽ bị tàn phá, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không hủy diệt hoàn toàn.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: \q Cả xứ sẽ bị tàn phá, \q nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không hủy diệt nó hoàn toàn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. \q 온 땅이 황폐해질 것이다. \q 그러나 내가 완전히 끝장내지는 않겠다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. \q 온 땅이 황폐해질 것이다. \q 그러나 내가 그 땅을 완전히 멸하지는 않겠다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. \q 온 땅이 망할 것이다. \q 그러나 내가 그 땅을 완전히 멸하지는 않겠다.

pt.L: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q Uma desolação será toda a terra, \q mas um fim completo não farei.
pt.B: Pois assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: \q A terra inteira será devastada, \q mas não a destruirei por completo.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: \q A terra inteira vai ficar arruinada, \q mas eu não vou destruí-la completamente.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q ምድሪቱ ሁሉ ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ \q ፍጹም ፍጻሜ ግን አላደርግም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላልና፦ \q ምድሪቱ ሁሉ ባድማ ትሆናለች፤ \q ነገር ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንዲህ ይላል፦ \q ምድሪቱ ሁሉ ትጠፋለች፤ \q ነገር ግን ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም።

hi.L: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यों कहते हैं: \q सारा देश उजाड़ हो जाएगा, \q फिर भी मैं उसका पूरा अंत न करूँगा।
hi.B: क्योंकि {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q सारा देश उजाड़ दिया जाएगा, \q पर मैं उसे पूरी तरह नष्ट न करूँगा।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} यह कहते हैं: \q सारा देश बरबाद हो जाएगा, \q पर मैं उसे पूरी तरह नष्ट नहीं करूँगा।

ru.L: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Опустошением станет вся земля, \q но полного конца {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не сделаю.
ru.B: Ведь так говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Вся земля будет опустошена, \q но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не уничтожу её совсем.
ru.R: Вот что говорит {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}: \q Вся земля будет разорена, \q но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не уничтожу её совсем.

ja.L: まことに、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 全地は荒れ果てた所となる。 \q しかし、わたしは滅ぼし尽くしはしない。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 国中が荒れ果てる。 \q しかし、わたしは完全に滅ぼしはしない。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}はこう言われる。 \q 国全体が廃虚になる。 \q しかし、わたしは完全に滅ぼしてしまうことはしない。

decisions.choice: a full end: complete destruction, an end with nothing left
decisions.reason: The word means a finishing off, destruction to the last. The same promise, that the LORD will not make a full end, returns in 5:10, 18; 30:11 and 46:28: judgment will be severe, but a remnant will be left.

decisions.choice: but ... not: a limit set within the judgment
alternatives: and I will make a full end of it (a change of one letter)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "not". It has been suggested that the word be read with a different letter as "of it", which would make the line a threat of total destruction. The text as it stands is kept, and the same promise in 5:10 and 5:18 supports it.

decisions.choice: the land: the land of Judah
decisions.reason: The same word as "the earth" in verses 23 and 28. Here, with the cities of verse 26, it is the land that will be laid waste.

decisions.choice: destroy it completely
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "make a full end" as a plain verb.

decisions.choice: "ፍጹም ፍጻሜ ግን አላደርግም" (Literal); "ፈጽሜ አላጠፋትም" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The promise that the end will not be complete returns in 5:10, 5:18, 30:11 and 46:28 and keeps one wording.

decisions.choice: kalah lo' 'e'eseh "滅ぼし尽くしはしない" (L), "完全に滅ぼしはしない" (B, R), one form for the refrain of 5:10, 5:18, 30:11, 46:28.
decisions.reason: The limit on judgment recurs; one wording lets it be heard.

source.text: עַל־זֹאת֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְקָדְר֥וּ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם מִמָּ֑עַל עַ֤ל כִּי־דִבַּ֨רְתִּי֙ זַמֹּ֔תִי וְלֹ֥א נִחַ֖מְתִּי וְלֹא־אָשׁ֥וּב מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: Because of this will mourn the earth, and will grow dark the heavens above, because I have spoken, I have purposed, and not I have relented, and not I will turn back from it.

en.L: On account of this the earth will mourn, \q and the heavens above will grow dark, \q because I have spoken, I have resolved, \q and I have not relented, and I will not turn back from it.
en.B: For this the earth will mourn, \q and the sky above will turn dark, \q because I have spoken and I have decided; \q I have not changed {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mind, and I will not turn back from it.
en.R: Because of this, the earth will mourn, \q and the sky will grow dark. \q I have spoken, and I have made up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} mind. \q I will not change it, and I will not turn back.

es.L: Por esto se enlutará la tierra, \q y se oscurecerán los cielos arriba, \q porque he hablado, lo he decidido, \q y no me he retractado, ni me volveré atrás.
es.B: Por esto la tierra estará de luto, \q y el cielo allá arriba se oscurecerá, \q porque he hablado y lo he decidido; \q no he cambiado de parecer, y no me volveré atrás.
es.R: Por eso la tierra estará de luto, \q y el cielo se oscurecerá. \q He hablado, y he tomado {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} decisión. \q No la cambiaré, y no me volveré atrás.

fr.L: À cause de cela, la terre sera en deuil, \q et les cieux en haut s’assombriront, \q parce que j’ai parlé, j’ai résolu, \q et je n’y ai pas renoncé, et je ne reviendrai pas en arrière.
fr.B: À cause de cela, la terre sera en deuil, \q et le ciel là-haut s’assombrira, \q parce que j’ai parlé, j’ai décidé ; \q je n’ai pas changé d’avis, et je ne reviendrai pas en arrière.
fr.R: À cause de cela, la terre sera en deuil, \q et le ciel deviendra sombre. \q J’ai parlé, et j’ai pris {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} décision. \q Je ne changerai pas d’avis, et je ne reculerai pas.

sw.L: Kwa sababu ya hili nchi itaomboleza, \q na mbingu juu zitakuwa giza, \q kwa sababu nimesema, nimekusudia, \q wala sijaghairi, wala sitarudi nyuma.
sw.B: Kwa sababu hii dunia itaomboleza, \q na anga la juu litatiwa giza, \q kwa sababu nimesema na nimeamua; \q sijaghairi, wala sitarudi nyuma.
sw.R: Kwa sababu hii, dunia itaomboleza, \q na anga litakuwa giza. \q Nimesema, na nimeamua. \q Sitabadili nia {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, wala sitarudi nyuma.

vi.L: Vì điều này, đất sẽ than khóc, \q và các tầng trời trên cao sẽ tối sầm, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quyết định, \q Ta đã không đổi ý, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại.
vi.B: Vì thế đất sẽ than khóc, \q và bầu trời trên cao sẽ tối sầm, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã định; \q Ta đã không đổi ý, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại.
vi.R: Vì điều này, đất sẽ than khóc, \q và bầu trời sẽ tối sầm. \q Ta đã phán, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã quyết định. \q Ta sẽ không đổi ý, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không rút lại.

ko.L: 이 때문에 땅이 슬퍼하고 \q 위의 하늘들이 어두워질 것이다. \q 내가 말했고 내가 작정했으니, \q 뉘우치지 않았고 그 일에서 돌이키지 않을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이 때문에 땅이 슬퍼하고 \q 위의 하늘이 캄캄해질 것이다. \q 내가 말했고 내가 결정했다. \q 나는 마음을 바꾸지 않았고, 그 일에서 돌이키지 않겠다.
ko.R: 이 때문에 땅이 슬퍼하고 \q 하늘이 어두워질 것이다. \q 내가 말했고 내가 마음을 정했다. \q 나는 마음을 바꾸지 않을 것이고, 물러서지도 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Por causa disto a terra ficará de luto, \q e os céus lá em cima escurecerão, \q porque eu falei, eu decidi, \q e não desisti, e não voltarei atrás disso.
pt.B: Por isso a terra ficará de luto, \q e o céu lá em cima ficará escuro, \q porque eu falei e decidi; \q não mudei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} decisão e não vou voltar atrás.
pt.R: Por causa disso, a terra vai ficar de luto, \q e o céu vai escurecer. \q Eu falei e tomei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} decisão. \q Não vou mudar de ideia nem voltar atrás.

am.L: ስለዚህ ምድር ታለቅሳለች፤ \q በላይም ያሉ ሰማያት ይጨልማሉ፤ \q ተናግሬአለሁና፤ አስቤአለሁም፤ \q አልተጸጸትኩም፤ ከእርሱም አልመለስም።
am.B: ስለዚህ ምድር ታለቅሳለች፤ \q በላይ ያለው ሰማይ ይጨልማል፤ \q ተናግሬአለሁና፤ ወስኛለሁም፤ \q አልተመለስኩም፤ ወደ ኋላም አልልም።
am.R: በዚህ ምክንያት ምድር ታለቅሳለች፤ \q ሰማዩም ይጨልማል። \q ተናግሬአለሁ፤ ወስኛለሁም። \q ሐሳቤን አልለውጥም፤ ወደ ኋላም አልመለስም።

hi.L: इस कारण पृथ्वी शोक करेगी, \q और ऊपर आकाश काला पड़ जाएगा, \q क्योंकि मैंने कहा है, मैंने ठान लिया है, \q और मैं पछताया नहीं, और उससे न फिरूँगा।
hi.B: इसी कारण पृथ्वी शोक करेगी, \q और ऊपर आकाश में अँधेरा छा जाएगा, \q क्योंकि मैंने कहा है और मैंने तय कर लिया है; \q मैंने अपना मन नहीं बदला, और मैं उससे पीछे न हटूँगा।
hi.R: इस कारण पृथ्वी शोक मनाएगी, \q और आकाश में अँधेरा छा जाएगा। \q मैंने कह दिया है, और मैंने ठान लिया है। \q मैं अपना मन नहीं बदलूँगा, और मैं पीछे नहीं हटूँगा।

ru.L: Из-за этого восплачет земля, \q и потемнеют небеса вверху, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} решил, \q и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не раскаялся и не отступлю от этого.
ru.B: Поэтому земля будет скорбеть, \q и небо вверху потемнеет, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сказал и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} решил; \q {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} не передумал и не отступлю от этого.
ru.R: Поэтому земля будет скорбеть, \q и небо потемнеет. \q Я сказал, и {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} принял решение. \q Я не изменю его и не отступлю.

ja.L: このために、地は嘆き、 \q 上なる天は暗くなる。 \q わたしが語り、わたしが決めたからだ。 \q わたしは思い直さず、それから引き返すこともない。
ja.B: このために、地は嘆き悲しみ、 \q 上の空は暗くなる。 \q わたしが語り、わたしが決めたからだ。 \q わたしは思い直さず、それを取りやめることもない。
ja.R: このために、地は嘆き悲しみ、 \q 空は暗くなる。 \q わたしは語り、心を決めた。 \q わたしはそれを変えず、取りやめることもない。

decisions.choice: the earth will mourn, the heavens grow dark: all creation grieves at the judgment
decisions.reason: The earth is pictured as a mourner and the sky as putting on dark clothes of grief (12:4; Isaiah 50:3; Hosea 4:3; Joel 2:10). The word "earth" here, as in verse 23, is wider than the land of verse 27.

decisions.choice: purposed: planned, resolved
decisions.reason: The verb means to form a plan and hold to it (51:12; Lamentations 2:17).

decisions.choice: I have not relented: I have not changed my course
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the LORD turning from a judgment he had announced when people repent (18:8; 26:3, 13, 19; Jonah 3:10). Here, with Judah unrepentant, he will not turn back.

decisions.choice: changed my mind / I will not change it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "relent" in everyday words.

decisions.choice: "no me he retractado" (L); "no he cambiado de parecer" (B); "No la cambiaré" (R)
decisions.reason: God's relenting is never "arrepentirse", as the Samuel terms note sets; Literal says "retractarse"; Balanced and Readable say he has not changed his mind, as the English levels do. The English Balanced has a deity_pronoun span on "my mind"; Spanish "cambiar de parecer" has no free pronoun, so Balanced has none.

decisions.choice: não desisti (L); não mudei a minha decisão (B); não vou mudar de ideia (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the verb is God turning from a judgment he has announced (m3). "Arrepender-se", the familiar word, now suggests regret for a wrong done, so each level says that God does not change his decision. Literal says "desistir" here and wherever the verb returns (15:6; 18:8, 10; 20:16; 26:3, 13, 19; 42:10); Balanced says "desistir" there too wherever the English Balanced says "relent", and "mudar a minha decisão" here, where it says "changed my mind"; Readable says "mudar de ideia".

decisions.choice: nicham "思い直す" (L, B), "変える" (R); lo' 'ashuv "引き返すこともない" (L), "取りやめることもない" (B, R): shuv of God not turning back, kept apart from the call 立ち帰る.
decisions.reason: The verb shuv here means God's turning from his word, not repentance.

source.text: מִקּ֨וֹל פָּרָ֜שׁ וְרֹ֣מֵה קֶ֗שֶׁת בֹּרַ֨חַת֙ כָּל־הָעִ֔יר בָּ֚אוּ בֶּעָבִ֔ים וּבַכֵּפִ֖ים עָל֑וּ כָּל־הָעִ֣יר עֲזוּבָ֔ה וְאֵין־יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בָּהֵ֖ן אִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] sound of horseman and shooter of bow fleeing [is] every the city; they go into thickets and among rocks they climb up; every the city [is] forsaken, and there is not dwelling in them a man.

en.L: At the sound of horseman and bowman \q every city is fleeing; \q they go into the thickets, and among the rocks they climb; \q every city is forsaken, \q and no one lives in them.
en.B: At the sound of horsemen and archers \q the people of every town run away. \q They go into the thickets; they climb up among the rocks. \q Every town is abandoned; \q no one lives in them.
en.R: When they hear the horsemen and the archers coming, \q the people in every town run away. \q They hide in the bushes and climb up among the rocks. \q All the towns are left empty. \q No one lives in them anymore.

es.L: Al ruido del jinete y del arquero \q huye toda la ciudad; \q se meten en los matorrales, y entre las peñas suben; \q toda ciudad está abandonada, \q y no habita en ellas nadie.
es.B: Al ruido de los jinetes y los arqueros \q la gente de cada ciudad huye. \q Se meten en los matorrales; trepan entre las peñas. \q Todas las ciudades están abandonadas; \q nadie vive en ellas.
es.R: Cuando oyen venir a los jinetes y a los arqueros, \q la gente de cada ciudad sale huyendo. \q Se esconden en los matorrales y trepan entre las rocas. \q Todas las ciudades quedan vacías. \q Ya nadie vive en ellas.

fr.L: Au bruit du cavalier et du tireur d’arc \q toute ville est en fuite ; \q ils entrent dans les fourrés, et parmi les rochers ils grimpent ; \q toute ville est abandonnée, \q et personne n’y habite.
fr.B: Au bruit des cavaliers et des archers, \q les habitants de chaque ville s’enfuient. \q Ils entrent dans les fourrés ; ils grimpent parmi les rochers. \q Toutes les villes sont abandonnées ; \q personne n’y habite.
fr.R: Quand ils entendent arriver les cavaliers et les archers, \q les habitants de toutes les villes s’enfuient. \q Ils se cachent dans les buissons et grimpent au milieu des rochers. \q Toutes les villes sont vides. \q Plus personne n’y habite.

sw.L: Kwa sauti ya mpanda farasi na mpiga upinde \q kila mji unakimbia; \q wanaingia vichakani, na kati ya miamba wanapanda; \q kila mji umeachwa, \q wala hakuna mtu anayekaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Kwa sauti ya wapanda farasi na wapiga mishale \q watu wa kila mji wanakimbia. \q Wanaingia vichakani; wanapanda kati ya miamba. \q Kila mji umeachwa; \q hakuna anayeishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Wanapowasikia wapanda farasi na wapiga mishale wakija, \q watu wa kila mji wanakimbia. \q Wanajificha vichakani na kupanda kati ya miamba. \q Miji yote imeachwa tupu. \q Hakuna mtu anayeishi humo tena.

vi.L: Nghe tiếng kỵ binh và cung thủ, \q mọi thành đều chạy trốn; \q chúng vào các bụi rậm, và trèo lên giữa các vầng đá; \q mọi thành đều bị bỏ hoang, \q và không một người nào ở trong đó.
vi.B: Nghe tiếng kỵ binh và cung thủ, \q dân mọi thành đều bỏ chạy. \q Họ chui vào bụi rậm; họ trèo lên giữa các vầng đá. \q Mọi thành đều bị bỏ hoang; \q không còn ai ở đó.
vi.R: Khi nghe tiếng kỵ binh và cung thủ kéo đến, \q dân trong mọi thành đều bỏ chạy. \q Họ trốn vào bụi rậm và trèo lên giữa các vầng đá. \q Mọi thành đều bị bỏ trống. \q Không còn ai sống ở đó nữa.

ko.L: 기병과 활 쏘는 자의 소리에 \q 모든 성읍이 도망한다. \q 그들이 덤불 속으로 들어가고 바위들 사이로 기어오른다. \q 모든 성읍이 버려지고, \q 그 안에 사는 사람이 없다.
ko.B: 기병들과 궁수들의 소리를 듣고 \q 성읍마다 사람들이 달아난다. \q 그들은 덤불 속으로 들어가고 바위 틈으로 기어오른다. \q 성읍마다 버려져서 \q 그 안에 사는 사람이 하나도 없다.
ko.R: 기병들과 활 쏘는 군인들이 오는 소리를 듣고 \q 성읍마다 사람들이 도망친다. \q 그들은 덤불 속에 숨고 바위 사이로 기어오른다. \q 모든 성읍이 텅 비었다. \q 이제는 아무도 그곳에 살지 않는다.

pt.L: Ao som do cavaleiro e do arqueiro \q foge toda a cidade; \q entram nos matagais, e sobem entre as rochas; \q toda cidade está abandonada, \q e ninguém mora nelas.
pt.B: Ao barulho dos cavaleiros e dos arqueiros \q o povo de cada cidade foge. \q Entram nos matagais; sobem por entre as rochas. \q Todas as cidades estão abandonadas; \q ninguém mora nelas.
pt.R: Quando ouvem os cavaleiros e os arqueiros chegando, \q as pessoas de todas as cidades fogem. \q Elas se escondem no mato e sobem por entre as rochas. \q Todas as cidades ficam vazias. \q Ninguém mora mais nelas.

am.L: ከፈረሰኛና ከቀስተኛ ድምፅ የተነሣ \q ከተማው ሁሉ ይሸሻል፤ \q ወደ ጥሻዎች ይገባሉ፤ በዓለቶችም መካከል ይወጣሉ፤ \q ከተማው ሁሉ ተትቷል፤ \q በእነርሱም የሚኖር ሰው የለም።
am.B: ከፈረሰኞችና ከቀስተኞች ድምፅ የተነሣ \q የየከተማው ሕዝብ ይሸሻል። \q ወደ ጥሻዎች ይገባሉ፤ በዓለቶች መካከል ይወጣሉ። \q ከተማው ሁሉ ተትቷል፤ \q በእነርሱ የሚኖር የለም።
am.R: ፈረሰኞቹና ቀስተኞቹ ሲመጡ በሰሙ ጊዜ \q በየከተማው ያሉ ሰዎች ይሸሻሉ። \q በቁጥቋጦ ውስጥ ይደበቃሉ፤ በዓለቶችም መካከል ይወጣሉ። \q ከተሞቹ ሁሉ ባዶ ቀርተዋል። \q ከእንግዲህ በእነርሱ የሚኖር የለም።

hi.L: घुड़सवार और धनुर्धारी के शब्द से \q हर एक नगर भागा जा रहा है; \q वे झाड़ियों में घुसते हैं, और चट्टानों पर चढ़ जाते हैं; \q हर एक नगर त्याग दिया गया है, \q और उनमें कोई मनुष्य नहीं रहता।
hi.B: घुड़सवारों और धनुर्धारियों का शोर सुनकर \q हर नगर के लोग भाग जाते हैं। \q वे झाड़ियों में घुस जाते हैं; वे चट्टानों पर चढ़ जाते हैं। \q हर नगर सूना पड़ा है; \q उनमें कोई नहीं रहता।
hi.R: जब वे घुड़सवारों और तीरंदाज़ों को आते सुनते हैं, \q तब हर नगर के लोग भाग जाते हैं। \q वे झाड़ियों में छिपते हैं और चट्टानों पर चढ़ जाते हैं। \q सब नगर ख़ाली छोड़ दिए गए हैं। \q अब उनमें कोई नहीं रहता।

ru.L: От шума всадника и стрелка из лука \q бежит весь город; \q уходят в чащи и на скалы взбираются; \q всякий город оставлен, \q и не живёт в них человек.
ru.B: При шуме всадников и лучников \q жители всех городов бегут. \q Они уходят в чащи, взбираются на скалы. \q Все города покинуты; \q никто в них не живёт.
ru.R: Когда люди слышат, что идут всадники и лучники, \q жители всех городов убегают. \q Они прячутся в кустах и взбираются на скалы. \q Все города опустели. \q Никто больше в них не живёт.

ja.L: 騎兵と射手の声に、 \q 町はみな逃げる。 \q 彼らは茂みに入り、岩の間に登る。 \q 町はみな捨てられ、 \q そこに住む者は一人もいない。
ja.B: 騎兵と弓を射る者のとどろきに、 \q どの町の人々も逃げ出す。 \q 彼らは茂みに入り込み、岩場によじ登る。 \q どの町も見捨てられ、 \q そこに住む者はいない。
ja.R: 騎兵や弓を射る兵士たちが来る音を聞くと、 \q どの町の人々も逃げ出す。 \q 彼らは茂みに隠れ、岩場によじ登る。 \q どの町も空っぽになり、 \q もう、だれも住んでいない。

decisions.choice: every the city: every city, the people of each town
decisions.reason: The words can mean "the whole city", but "in them" at the end of the verse shows that many towns are meant. The town stands for its people, who flee.

decisions.choice: thickets ... rocks: dense brush and rocky crags, places to hide
decisions.reason: The first word is rare and seems to mean thick undergrowth; the second means rocks or cliffs. In times of invasion people hid in caves, thickets and rocks (1 Samuel 13:6; Isaiah 2:19, 21).

decisions.choice: horseman and archer: the enemy's cavalry and bowmen
decisions.reason: The armies of Mesopotamia fought with horsemen, chariots and archers (6:23; 50:42). The words are singular, standing for the whole force.

decisions.choice: the people of every town
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the people" of each town flee (m1).

decisions.choice: parash "騎兵", romeh qeshet "射手" (L), "弓を射る者" (B), "弓を射る兵士" (R); 'ish "一人も" with no gender span (the English has none).
decisions.reason: The English per level.

source.text: וְאַ֨תְּ שָׁד֜וּד מַֽה־תַּעֲשִׂ֗י כִּֽי־תִלְבְּשִׁ֨י שָׁנִ֜י כִּי־תַעְדִּ֣י עֲדִי־זָהָ֗ב כִּֽי־תִקְרְעִ֤י בַפּוּךְ֙ עֵינַ֔יִךְ לַשָּׁ֖וְא תִּתְיַפִּ֑י מָאֲסוּ־בָ֥ךְ עֹגְבִ֖ים נַפְשֵׁ֥ךְ יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, devastated [one], what will you do? That you dress [in] scarlet, that you adorn [yourself with] ornaments of gold, that you enlarge with eye paint your eyes, in vain you make yourself beautiful; reject you lovers; your life they seek.

en.L: And you, devastated one, what will you do? Though you dress in scarlet, though you adorn [yourself with] ornaments of gold, though you enlarge your eyes with paint, \q in vain you make yourself beautiful. \q [Your] lovers reject you; they seek your life.
en.B: And you, ruined one, what will you do? Though you dress in scarlet, though you put on jewelry of gold, though you make your eyes look large with paint, \q you make yourself beautiful for nothing. \q Your lovers reject you; they are out to take your life.
en.R: And you, Jerusalem, now ruined, what will you do? You may dress in bright red clothes and wear gold jewelry. You may paint around your eyes to make them look bigger. \q But it is no use making yourself beautiful. \q The nations you tried to win as lovers hate you now. They want to kill you.

es.L: Y tú, devastada, ¿qué harás? Aunque te vistas de escarlata, aunque te adornes [con] joyas de oro, aunque agrandes tus ojos con pintura, \q en vano te embelleces. \q [Tus] amantes te desprecian; buscan tu vida.
es.B: Y tú, arruinada, ¿qué harás? Aunque te vistas de escarlata, aunque te pongas joyas de oro, aunque te pintes los ojos para que se vean grandes, \q te embelleces para nada. \q Tus amantes te desprecian; quieren quitarte la vida.
es.R: Y tú, Jerusalén, ahora arruinada, ¿qué harás? Puedes vestirte de rojo brillante y ponerte joyas de oro. Puedes pintarte alrededor de los ojos para que se vean más grandes. \q Pero no sirve de nada que te pongas hermosa. \q Las naciones que quisiste ganarte como amantes ahora te odian. Quieren matarte.

fr.L: Et toi, dévastée, que feras-tu ? Quand tu t’habillerais d’écarlate, quand tu te parerais d’ornements d’or, quand tu agrandirais tes yeux avec du fard, \q en vain tu te fais belle. \q [Tes] amants te rejettent ; ils en veulent à ta vie.
fr.B: Et toi, la ruinée, que vas-tu faire ? Même si tu t’habilles d’écarlate, si tu te pares de bijoux d’or, si tu agrandis tes yeux avec du fard, \q c’est pour rien que tu te fais belle. \q Tes amants te rejettent ; ils cherchent à t’ôter la vie.
fr.R: Et toi, Jérusalem, maintenant ruinée, que vas-tu faire ? Tu peux t’habiller de vêtements rouge vif et porter des bijoux d’or. Tu peux te maquiller les yeux pour les faire paraître plus grands. \q Mais cela ne sert à rien de te faire belle. \q Les nations que tu as voulu séduire comme des amants te détestent maintenant. Elles veulent te tuer.

sw.L: Nawe, uliyeangamizwa, utafanya nini? Ingawa unavaa nguo nyekundu, ingawa unajipamba [kwa] mapambo ya dhahabu, ingawa unayapanua macho yako kwa wanja, \q bure unajifanya mzuri. \q Wapenzi [wako] wanakukataa; wanautafuta uhai wako.
sw.B: Nawe uliyeharibiwa, utafanya nini? Ingawa unavaa nguo nyekundu, ingawa unajivika vito vya dhahabu, ingawa unapaka wanja macho yako yaonekane makubwa, \q unajirembesha bure. \q Wapenzi wako wanakukataa; wanataka kukuua.
sw.R: Nawe Yerusalemu, uliyeharibiwa sasa, utafanya nini? Unaweza kuvaa nguo nyekundu na kuvaa vito vya dhahabu. Unaweza kupaka wanja macho yako yaonekane makubwa. \q Lakini haifai kitu kujifanya mzuri. \q Mataifa uliyojaribu kuyapata kama wapenzi sasa yanakuchukia. Yanataka kukuua.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, kẻ bị tàn phá kia, ngươi sẽ làm gì? Dù ngươi mặc áo đỏ thắm, dù ngươi đeo đồ trang sức bằng vàng, dù ngươi tô mắt cho to bằng phấn, \q ngươi làm đẹp cho mình cũng vô ích. \q [Các] tình nhân khinh bỏ ngươi; chúng tìm hại mạng sống ngươi.
vi.B: Còn ngươi, kẻ bị tàn phá kia, ngươi sẽ làm gì? Dù ngươi mặc áo đỏ thắm, dù ngươi đeo nữ trang bằng vàng, dù ngươi kẻ mắt cho to, \q ngươi làm đẹp cũng chẳng ích gì. \q Tình nhân của ngươi khinh bỏ ngươi; chúng tìm cách lấy mạng ngươi.
vi.R: Hỡi Giê-ru-sa-lem, bây giờ ngươi đã bị tàn phá, ngươi sẽ làm gì? Ngươi có thể mặc áo màu đỏ tươi và đeo nữ trang bằng vàng. Ngươi có thể kẻ quanh mắt cho mắt trông to hơn. \q Nhưng ngươi làm đẹp cũng vô ích. \q Những nước ngươi tìm cách lấy lòng như tình nhân giờ ghét bỏ ngươi. Chúng muốn giết ngươi.

ko.L: 그리고 너, 황폐해진 자야, 너는 무엇을 하려느냐? 네가 붉은 옷을 입고, 금 장신구로 [몸을] 꾸미고, 물감으로 네 눈을 크게 그린다 해도, \q 네가 아름답게 꾸미는 것은 헛되다. \q [네] 애인들이 너를 거절한다. 그들이 네 목숨을 찾는다.
ko.B: 망한 너는 이제 무엇을 하려느냐? 네가 붉은 옷을 입고, 금 장신구를 달고, 눈 화장으로 눈을 크게 꾸민다 해도, \q 네가 아름답게 꾸미는 것은 다 헛일이다. \q 네 애인들이 너를 버렸다. 그들은 네 목숨을 노린다.
ko.R: 이제 망해 버린 예루살렘아, 너는 무엇을 하려느냐? 너는 새빨간 옷을 입고 금 장신구를 달 수도 있다. 눈을 크게 보이려고 눈 둘레를 칠할 수도 있다. \q 그러나 아름답게 꾸며 보아야 아무 소용이 없다. \q 네가 애인으로 삼으려던 나라들이 이제는 너를 미워한다. 그들은 너를 죽이려 한다.

pt.L: E tu, devastada, que farás? Ainda que te vistas de escarlate, ainda que te enfeites com enfeites de ouro, ainda que alargues os teus olhos com pintura, \q em vão te fazes bela. \q [Os] amantes te desprezam; eles buscam a tua vida.
pt.B: E tu, arruinada, o que vais fazer? Ainda que te vistas de vermelho vivo, ainda que ponhas joias de ouro, ainda que aumentes os olhos com pintura, \q de nada adianta te embelezares. \q Os teus amantes te rejeitam; querem tirar a tua vida.
pt.R: E tu, Jerusalém, agora arruinada, o que vais fazer? Podes te vestir de roupas vermelhas e usar joias de ouro. Podes pintar em volta dos olhos para que pareçam maiores. \q Mas não adianta ficar bonita. \q As nações que tentaste conquistar como amantes agora te odeiam. Elas querem te matar.

am.L: አንቺም የወደምሽ ሆይ፣ ምን ታደርጊያለሽ? ቀይ ልብስ ብትለብሺ፣ በወርቅ ጌጦች ብታጌጪ፣ ዓይኖችሽንም በኩል ብታሰፊ፣ \q በከንቱ ራስሽን ታስውቢያለሽ፤ \q ወዳጆችሽ ይንቁሻል፤ ነፍስሽን ይፈልጋሉ።
am.B: አንቺም የፈራረስሽ ሆይ፣ ምን ታደርጊያለሽ? ቀይ ልብስ ብትለብሺ፣ የወርቅ ጌጣጌጥ ብታደርጊ፣ ዓይኖችሽንም ትልቅ ለማስመሰል ኩል ብትኳዪ፣ \q ራስሽን የምታስውቢው በከንቱ ነው። \q ወዳጆችሽ ንቀውሻል፤ ሕይወትሽን ሊያጠፉ ይፈልጋሉ።
am.R: አንቺ አሁን የወደምሽው ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፣ ምን ታደርጊያለሽ? ደማቅ ቀይ ልብስ ልትለብሺና የወርቅ ጌጣጌጥ ልታደርጊ ትችያለሽ። ዓይኖችሽ ትልቅ እንዲመስሉ ኩል ልትኳዪ ትችያለሽ። \q ነገር ግን ራስሽን ማስዋብሽ ምንም አይጠቅምም። \q ወዳጆች ልታደርጊያቸው የሞከርሻቸው ሕዝቦች አሁን ይጠሉሻል። ሊገድሉሽ ይፈልጋሉ።

hi.L: और तुम, हे उजड़ी हुई, तुम क्या करोगी? चाहे तुम लाल रंग के वस्त्र पहनो, चाहे सोने के गहनों से [अपने को] सजाओ, चाहे अपनी आँखों को अंजन से बड़ा करो, \q तुम व्यर्थ ही अपने को सुंदर बनाती हो। \q [तुम्हारे] यार तुम्हें तुच्छ जानते हैं; वे तुम्हारे प्राण के खोजी हैं।
hi.B: और तुम, हे उजड़ी हुई, तुम क्या करोगी? चाहे तुम लाल रंग के वस्त्र पहनो, चाहे सोने के गहने पहनो, चाहे अंजन लगाकर अपनी आँखों को बड़ा दिखाओ, \q तुम्हारा सजना-सँवरना व्यर्थ है। \q तुम्हारे यार तुम्हें ठुकराते हैं; वे तुम्हारी जान लेने पर तुले हैं।
hi.R: और हे यरूशलेम, अब तुम उजड़ गई हो; तुम क्या करोगी? तुम चटकीले लाल कपड़े पहन सकती हो और सोने के गहने पहन सकती हो। तुम अपनी आँखों को बड़ा दिखाने के लिए उनके चारों ओर काजल लगा सकती हो। \q पर अपने को सुंदर बनाने से कोई लाभ नहीं। \q जिन देशों को तुमने अपना यार बनाना चाहा, वे अब तुमसे घृणा करते हैं। वे तुम्हें मार डालना चाहते हैं।

ru.L: А ты, опустошённая, что будешь делать? Хотя ты одеваешься в багряницу, хотя украшаешь [себя] золотыми украшениями, хотя расширяешь краской свои глаза, \q напрасно ты наряжаешься. \q Любовники отвергают тебя; они ищут твоей жизни.
ru.B: А ты, разорённая, что будешь делать? Хотя ты одеваешься в багряное, хотя надеваешь золотые украшения, хотя краской делаешь свои глаза большими, \q ты напрасно делаешь себя красивой. \q Твои любовники отвергают тебя; они хотят отнять твою жизнь.
ru.R: А ты, Иерусалим, что ты будешь делать теперь, когда ты разорена? Ты можешь одеться в ярко-красную одежду и надеть золотые украшения. Ты можешь подвести глаза, чтобы они казались больше. \q Но бесполезно наряжаться. \q Народы, которых ты пыталась сделать своими любовниками, теперь ненавидят тебя. Они хотят тебя убить.

ja.L: そして、荒らされたあなたよ、あなたはどうするのか？たとえ緋色の衣を着、金の飾りで身を飾り、目の化粧墨で目を大きく見せても、 \q むなしく、あなたは自分を美しくしている。 \q 恋人たちはあなたを退け、あなたの命を狙っている。
ja.B: 滅ぼされたあなたよ、どうするつもりか？緋色の衣を着ても、金の宝飾品を着けても、目に化粧墨を塗って大きく見せても、 \q 美しく装うのはむだなことだ。 \q 恋人たちはあなたを嫌い、あなたの命を奪おうとしている。
ja.R: 今は滅ぼされてしまったエルサレムよ、あなたはどうするのか？明るい赤の服を着て、金の宝飾品を着けるかもしれない。目の周りに化粧をして、目を大きく見せるかもしれない。 \q しかし、美しく装っても、むだだ。 \q あなたが恋人にしようとした国々は、今ではあなたを嫌い、あなたを殺そうとしている。

decisions.choice: you, devastated one: Jerusalem, spoken to as a woman
decisions.reason: The words are feminine singular, addressed to the city, which is named "the daughter of Zion" in verse 31. She is spoken of as already ruined, so sure is the judgment.

decisions.choice: scarlet, gold ornaments, eye paint: a woman dressing to attract
decisions.reason: Rich red cloth, gold jewelry and dark paint around the eyes were signs of wealth and beauty. Jezebel painted her eyes before she met Jehu (2 Kings 9:30), and Ezekiel 23:40 uses the same picture for Jerusalem courting other nations.

decisions.choice: lovers: the foreign nations Judah courted as allies
decisions.reason: Jeremiah pictures Judah's search for help from Egypt and Assyria as a woman chasing lovers (2:33, 36; 3:1; 22:20; 30:14). Those she courted will turn on her.

decisions.choice: they seek your life: they want to kill you
decisions.reason: To "seek someone's life" means to try to kill them (11:21; 19:7; Exodus 4:19).

decisions.choice: that ... that ... that: even though you do these things
decisions.reason: The three clauses with the small word usually meaning "that" or "for" set out what she does, and the line "in vain you make yourself beautiful" answers them all: none of it will help.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem ... The nations you tried to win as lovers
decisions.reason: Readable names the city (m1) and explains who the lovers are (m3).

decisions.choice: shani "緋色の衣" (L, B), "明るい赤の服" (R); puk "目の化粧墨" (L, B), "目の周りに化粧" (R); 'ogvim "恋人たち" (L, B), "恋人にしようとした国々" (R); Jerusalem addressed "あなた".
decisions.reason: A woman dressing to attract (m2); plain words.

source.text: כִּי֩ ק֨וֹל כְּחוֹלָ֜ה שָׁמַ֗עְתִּי צָרָה֙ כְּמַבְכִּירָ֔ה ק֧וֹל בַּת־צִיּ֛וֹן תִּתְיַפֵּ֖חַ תְּפָרֵ֣שׂ כַּפֶּ֑יהָ אֽוֹי־נָ֣א לִ֔י כִּֽי־עָיְפָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י לְהֹרְגִֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: For a voice like [one] in labor I have heard, distress like [one] bearing a first child, [the] voice of [the] daughter of Zion; she gasps for breath, she spreads out her palms: Woe now to me, for faints my soul before killers!

en.L: For a cry as of [a woman] in labor I have heard, distress as of [one] bearing her first child, \q the cry of the daughter of Zion; she gasps for breath, she spreads out her hands: \q "Woe [is] me now, \q for my soul faints before killers!"
en.B: I hear a scream like that of a woman in labor, the agony of one bearing her first child: \q it is the voice of Daughter Zion, fighting for breath and holding out her hands: \q "Woe is me! \q My life is ebbing away before killers!"
en.R: I hear a cry like a woman giving birth, the painful cry of a woman having her first baby. \q It is the cry of the people of Zion, like a woman gasping for breath and reaching out her hands for help: \q "How terrible this is for me! \q I am fainting, and murderers are all around me!"

es.L: Porque un grito como de [mujer] de parto he oído, angustia como de [la que] da a luz a su primer hijo, \q el grito de la hija de Sion; jadea, extiende sus manos: \q «¡Ay de mí ahora, \q porque mi alma desfallece ante los asesinos!».
es.B: Oigo un grito como el de una mujer de parto, la angustia de la que da a luz a su primer hijo: \q es la voz de la hija de Sion, que lucha por respirar y extiende las manos: \q «¡Ay de mí! \q ¡Mi vida se apaga ante los asesinos!».
es.R: Oigo un grito como el de una mujer que da a luz, el grito de dolor de una mujer que tiene su primer bebé. \q Es el grito del pueblo de Sion, como una mujer que jadea y extiende las manos pidiendo ayuda: \q «¡Qué terrible es esto para mí! \q ¡Me desmayo, y los asesinos me rodean!».

fr.L: Car j’ai entendu un cri comme [celui d’une femme] en travail, une angoisse comme [celle d’une femme] qui enfante son premier-né, \q le cri de la fille de Sion ; elle halète, elle étend les mains : \q « Malheur à moi maintenant, \q car mon âme défaille devant des tueurs ! »
fr.B: J’entends un cri comme celui d’une femme en travail, l’angoisse d’une femme qui met au monde son premier enfant : \q c’est la voix de la fille de Sion, qui cherche son souffle et tend les mains : \q « Malheur à moi ! \q Ma vie s’en va devant des meurtriers ! »
fr.R: J’entends un cri comme celui d’une femme qui accouche, le cri de douleur d’une femme qui a son premier bébé. \q C’est le cri du peuple de Sion, comme une femme qui n’arrive plus à respirer et qui tend les mains pour appeler à l’aide : \q « Quel malheur pour moi ! \q Je m’évanouis, et des meurtriers m’entourent ! »

sw.L: Kwa maana nimesikia sauti kama ya [mwanamke] aliye na utungu, dhiki kama ya [yule] anayezaa mtoto wake wa kwanza, \q sauti ya binti Sayuni; anatweta, anainyosha mikono yake: \q "Ole wangu sasa, \q kwa maana nafsi yangu inazimia mbele ya wauaji!"
sw.B: Ninasikia kilio kama cha mwanamke mwenye utungu, maumivu ya yule anayezaa mtoto wake wa kwanza: \q ni sauti ya Binti Sayuni, akitweta na kuinyosha mikono yake: \q "Ole wangu! \q Uhai wangu unanitoka mbele ya wauaji!"
sw.R: Ninasikia kilio kama cha mwanamke anayezaa, kilio cha uchungu cha mwanamke anayezaa mtoto wake wa kwanza. \q Ni kilio cha watu wa Sayuni, kama mwanamke anayetweta na kunyosha mikono yake kuomba msaada: \q "Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu! \q Ninazimia, na wauaji wamenizunguka pande zote!"

vi.L: Vì tôi đã nghe tiếng kêu như [người đàn bà] đang chuyển dạ, tiếng quặn thắt như [người] sinh con đầu lòng, \q tiếng của con gái Si-ôn; nàng thở hổn hển, nàng giơ tay ra: \q "Khốn cho tôi bây giờ, \q vì linh hồn tôi ngất lịm trước những kẻ giết người!"
vi.B: Tôi nghe tiếng thét như tiếng người đàn bà đang chuyển dạ, tiếng quằn quại của người sinh con đầu lòng: \q đó là tiếng của con gái Si-ôn, đang thở hổn hển và giơ tay ra: \q "Khốn cho tôi! \q Mạng sống tôi đang lịm dần trước những kẻ giết người!"
vi.R: Tôi nghe một tiếng kêu như tiếng người đàn bà đang sinh nở, tiếng kêu đau đớn của người sinh con đầu lòng. \q Đó là tiếng kêu của dân Si-ôn, như người đàn bà thở hổn hển và đưa tay ra xin cứu giúp: \q "Thật khốn khổ cho tôi! \q Tôi sắp ngất đi, và những kẻ giết người đang vây quanh tôi!"

ko.L: 해산하는 [여자] 같은 소리를, 첫아이를 낳는 [여자] 같은 고통을 내가 들었다. \q 딸 시온의 소리다. 그 여자가 숨을 헐떡이며 두 손을 펴고 \q "이제 내게 화가 있다! \q 살인자들 앞에서 내 영혼이 기절한다!" [하고 말한다].
ko.B: 해산하는 여자의 비명 같은 소리, 첫아이를 낳는 여자의 고통스러운 소리가 들린다. \q 딸 시온이 숨을 헐떡이며 두 손을 내밀고 외치는 소리다. \q "내게 화가 있다! \q 살인자들 앞에서 내 목숨이 꺼져 간다!"
ko.R: 아기를 낳는 여자의 울부짖음 같은 소리가 들린다. 첫아이를 낳는 여자의 고통스러운 외침이다. \q 그것은 시온 백성이 우는 소리다. 숨을 헐떡이며 도와 달라고 두 손을 내미는 여자와 같다. \q "나에게 끔찍한 일이 닥쳤다! \q 나는 기절할 것 같다. 살인자들이 나를 에워싸고 있다!"

pt.L: Pois ouvi um grito como de [mulher] em trabalho de parto, uma angústia como de [quem] dá à luz o primeiro filho, \q o grito da filha de Sião; ela ofega, ela estende as mãos: \q "Ai de mim agora, \q pois a minha alma desfalece diante dos assassinos!"
pt.B: Ouço um grito como o de uma mulher em trabalho de parto, a angústia de quem dá à luz o primeiro filho: \q é a voz da filha de Sião, lutando para respirar e estendendo as mãos: \q "Ai de mim! \q A minha vida se esvai diante dos assassinos!"
pt.R: Ouço um grito como o de uma mulher dando à luz, o grito de dor de uma mulher tendo o primeiro filho. \q É o grito do povo de Sião, como uma mulher que luta para respirar e estende as mãos pedindo ajuda: \q "Que desgraça para mim! \q Estou desmaiando, e há assassinos à minha volta!"

am.L: እንደ ምጥ ያለች ሴት ድምፅ፣ በኩሯን እንደምትወልድ ሴት ጭንቀት ሰምቻለሁና፤ \q የጽዮንን ልጅ ድምፅ፤ ትቃትታለች፤ እጆቿን ትዘረጋለች፦ \q «አሁን ወዮልኝ! \q ነፍሴ በገዳዮች ፊት ዝላለችና!»
am.B: ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ጩኸት፣ የመጀመሪያ ልጇን እንደምትወልድ ሴት ሥቃይ እሰማለሁ፤ \q ይህ የልጅቷ ጽዮን ድምፅ ነው፤ ትንፋሽ አጥሯት እጆቿን ዘርግታ እንዲህ ትላለች፦ \q «ወዮልኝ! \q ሕይወቴ በገዳዮች ፊት እያለቀች ነው!»
am.R: እንደምትወልድ ሴት ያለ ጩኸት እሰማለሁ፤ የመጀመሪያ ልጇን እንደምትወልድ ሴት የሥቃይ ጩኸት። \q ይህ የጽዮን ሕዝብ ጩኸት ነው፤ ትንፋሽ እንዳጠራትና ለእርዳታ እጆቿን እንደምትዘረጋ ሴት ናት፦ \q «ይህ ለእኔ ምንኛ አስከፊ ነው! \q እዝላለሁ፤ ገዳዮችም ከብበውኛል!»

hi.L: क्योंकि मैंने जच्चा की-सी चीख़ सुनी है, पहलौठे को जननेवाली की-सी पीड़ा, \q सिय्योन की बेटी की चीख़; वह हाँफ रही है, वह अपने हाथ फैलाती है: \q "हाय, अब मुझ पर, \q क्योंकि हत्यारों के सामने मेरा प्राण मूर्छित होता है!"
hi.B: मैं प्रसव-पीड़ा में पड़ी स्त्री की-सी चीख़ सुनता हूँ, पहले बच्चे को जनती स्त्री की-सी वेदना: \q यह सिय्योन की बेटी की आवाज़ है, जो साँस के लिए तड़प रही है और अपने हाथ फैला रही है: \q "हाय मुझ पर! \q हत्यारों के सामने मेरे प्राण निकले जा रहे हैं!"
hi.R: मैं ऐसी चीख़ सुनता हूँ जैसे कोई स्त्री बच्चे को जन्म दे रही हो, जैसे कोई स्त्री दर्द से चिल्लाती हो जब उसका पहला बच्चा होनेवाला हो। \q यह सिय्योन के लोगों की चीख़ है, उस स्त्री की तरह जो हाँफ रही हो और मदद के लिए हाथ फैला रही हो: \q "मेरे लिए कितना भयानक है! \q मैं बेहोश हो रही हूँ, और हत्यारे मुझे चारों ओर से घेरे हुए हैं!"

ru.L: Ведь голос, как у [женщины] в родах, я слышу, муку, как у рождающей первенца, \q голос дочери Сиона; она задыхается, простирает свои руки: \q «Горе мне теперь, \q ведь изнемогает моя душа перед убийцами!»
ru.B: Я слышу крик, как у женщины в родах, муку, как у рождающей первенца: \q это голос дочери Сиона, которая задыхается и простирает руки: \q «Горе мне! \q Жизнь моя угасает перед убийцами!»
ru.R: Я слышу крик, как у женщины в родах, мучительный крик женщины, которая рожает первого ребёнка. \q Это крик народа Сиона, как женщины, которая задыхается и протягивает руки за помощью: \q «Беда мне! \q Я теряю силы, и вокруг меня убийцы!»

ja.L: まことに、わたしは産みの苦しみにある[女]のような声を聞いた。初めての子を産む[女]のような苦しみを。 \q 娘シオンの声だ。娘シオンはあえぎ、両手を差し伸べる。 \q 「ああ、今わたしは災いだ。 \q わたしの魂は、殺す者たちの前で気を失う！」
ja.B: わたしは、産みの苦しみにある女のような叫びを聞く。初めての子を産む女の苦しみのような叫びを。 \q それは娘シオンの声だ。娘シオンはあえぎながら、両手を差し伸べる。 \q 「ああ、わたしは災いだ！ \q わたしの命は、殺す者たちの前で消え入ろうとしている！」
ja.R: わたしは、子どもを産む女の人のような叫びを聞く。初めての子を産む女の人の、苦しそうな叫びだ。 \q それは、シオンの人々の叫びだ。息も絶え絶えになり、助けを求めて両手を差し伸べる女の人のようだ。 \q 「ああ、わたしはなんとひどい目にあうことか！ \q わたしは気が遠くなる。人殺したちがわたしを取り囲んでいる！」

decisions.choice: like a woman in labor with her first child: helpless, overwhelming anguish
decisions.reason: The pain of childbirth is the prophets' picture for terror that cannot be escaped (6:24; 13:21; 22:23; 30:6; Isaiah 13:8). A first birth was known to be the hardest and most frightening.

decisions.choice: the daughter of Zion: Jerusalem and its people, pictured as a young woman
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah 1:8, Zion stands for Jerusalem, and "daughter" pictures the city and its people as a woman, loved and vulnerable. Here the picture is of a woman in labor who finds herself among killers.

decisions.choice: she spreads out her palms: a gesture of pleading for help
decisions.reason: Spreading out the hands was a gesture of prayer or of begging for help (Lamentations 1:17; Isaiah 1:15). Here no help comes.

decisions.choice: my soul faints before killers: my life is ebbing away in front of those who will kill me
decisions.reason: "Soul" means the self or life, and the verb means to be weary or faint. The murderers stand over her as she gives birth.

decisions.choice: the daughter of Zion (L); Daughter Zion (B); the people of Zion (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording, as in Isaiah. Readable says "the people of Zion" and keeps the picture of one woman with "like a woman", so that "her hands" and "me" still fit (m2).

decisions.choice: Woe is me (L, B); How terrible this is for me (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for a cry of woe said of oneself, as in Isaiah. Literal also keeps the small word "now", which strengthens the cry.

decisions.choice: for help ... are all around me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the outstretched hands mean (m3) and where the killers are (m4).

decisions.choice: "la hija de Sion" (L, B); "el pueblo de Sion" (R)
decisions.reason: Daughter Zion as the terms note sets it for Spanish.

decisions.choice: binti Sayuni (Literal); Binti Sayuni (Balanced); watu wa Sayuni (Readable)
decisions.reason: Daughter Zion worded as the terms note and 2 Kings 19:21.

decisions.choice: Ole wangu (Literal, Balanced); Mambo ni mabaya sana kwangu (Readable)
decisions.reason: The cry of woe over oneself, worded as the terms note sets it (1 Kings 13:30).

decisions.choice: "la fille de Sion" (L, B); "le peuple de Sion" (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: The settled French wording, as 2 Kings 19:21; Readable keeps the picture of one woman with "comme une femme".

decisions.choice: "con gái Si-ôn" (Literal, Balanced); "dân Si-ôn" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for daughter Zion, as 2 Kings 19:21.

decisions.choice: 딸 시온 (Literal, Balanced); 시온 백성 (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for Daughter Zion, as 2 Kings 19:21 (= Isaiah 37:22), at each level through the book.

decisions.choice: a filha de Sião (L, B); o povo de Sião (R)
decisions.reason: As Isaiah 1:8 sets it in Portuguese for the prophets: "a filha de Sião" at Literal and Balanced, where the English Balanced says "Daughter Zion", which is not natural Portuguese, and "o povo de Sião" at Readable.

decisions.choice: सिय्योन की बेटी (L, B); सिय्योन के लोग (R)
decisions.reason: "Daughter Zion" is सिय्योन की बेटी, as the terms note and Isaiah 1:8 have it; Readable says सिय्योन के लोग and keeps the picture of one woman with "उस स्त्री की तरह", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: дочь Сиона (L, B); народ Сиона (R)
decisions.reason: Bat-tsiyyon in the Prophets note's form, as Isaiah 1:8 has it; Readable names the people, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: bat Tsiyyon "娘シオン" (L, B), "シオンの人々" (R), as Isaiah 1:8; repeated as the subject instead of "彼女"; 'oy na li "ああ、今わたしは災いだ" (L), "ああ、わたしは災いだ" (B), "ああ、わたしはなんとひどい目にあうことか" (R), as Isaiah 6:5.
decisions.reason: The prophetic conventions; a city is never "彼女".
